   154→class TestCommonApplyFixer:
   155→    """Tests for apply_fixer() template."""
   156→
   157→    def test_applies_transform_and_writes(self, tmp_path):
   158→        """apply_fixer writes transformed content atomically."""
   159→        ts_file = tmp_path / "test.ts"
   160→        ts_file.write_text("line_a\nline_b\nline_c\n")
   161→
   162→        entries = [{"file": str(ts_file), "target": "line_b"}]
   163→
   164→        def transform(lines, file_entries):
   165→            new_lines = [line for line in lines if "line_b" not in line]
   166→            return new_lines, ["line_b"]
   167→
   168→        results = apply_fixer(entries, transform, dry_run=False)
   169→        assert len(results) == 1
   170→        assert results[0]["removed"] == ["line_b"]
   171→        assert results[0]["lines_removed"] == 1
   172→        assert "line_b" not in ts_file.read_text()
   173→
   174→    def test_dry_run_does_not_write(self, tmp_path):
   175→        """apply_fixer with dry_run=True does not modify the file."""
   176→        ts_file = tmp_path / "test.ts"
   177→        original = "line_a\nline_b\nline_c\n"
   178→        ts_file.write_text(original)
   179→
   180→        entries = [{"file": str(ts_file), "target": "line_b"}]
   181→
   182→        def transform(lines, file_entries):
   183→            new_lines = [line for line in lines if "line_b" not in line]
   184→            return new_lines, ["line_b"]
   185→
   186→        results = apply_fixer(entries, transform, dry_run=True)
   187→        assert len(results) == 1
   188→        assert ts_file.read_text() == original
   189→
   190→    def test_no_change_no_result(self, tmp_path):
   191→        """If transform returns the same content, no result is produced."""
   192→        ts_file = tmp_path / "test.ts"
   193→        ts_file.write_text("line_a\nline_b\n")
   194→
   195→        entries = [{"file": str(ts_file)}]
   196→
   197→        def transform(lines, file_entries):
   198→            return lines, []
   199→
   200→        results = apply_fixer(entries, transform, dry_run=False)
   201→        assert results == []
   202→
   203→    def test_atomic_write_no_tmp_left(self, tmp_path):
   204→        """After apply_fixer, no .tmp files remain."""
   205→        ts_file = tmp_path / "test.ts"
   206→        ts_file.write_text("a\nb\nc\n")
   207→
   208→        entries = [{"file": str(ts_file)}]
   209→
   210→        def transform(lines, file_entries):
   211→            return [line for line in lines if "b" not in line], ["b"]
   212→
   213→        apply_fixer(entries, transform, dry_run=False)
   214→        tmp_files = list(tmp_path.glob("*.tmp"))
   215→        assert tmp_files == []

   223→class TestFixUnusedImports:
   224→    """Tests for fix_unused_imports()."""

   226→    def test_remove_entire_import(self, tmp_path):
   227→        """An entirely unused import statement is removed."""

   229→        ts_file.write_text(

   231→            import { unused } from './utils';

   233→
   234→            console.log(used);
   235→        """)
   236→        )
   237→        entries = [

   712→class TestFindIfChainEnd:
   713→    """Tests for _find_if_chain_end()."""
   714→
   715→    def test_simple_if_block(self):
   716→        """Single if block end is found correctly."""
   717→        lines = ["if (x) {\n", "  doStuff();\n", "}\n"]
   718→        assert _find_if_chain_end(lines, 0) == 2
   719→
   720→    def test_if_else_chain_same_line(self):
   721→        """if/else chain where else is on the closing-brace line continues tracking."""
   722→        # When "} else {" is on one line, the brace tracker sees } (depth=0),
   723→        # recognizes "else" follows, breaks out of the char loop, but does NOT
   724→        # re-enter the second { on that line.  So brace_depth stays 0 and the
   725→        # function never finds the closing } of the else branch.  It falls
   726→        # through and returns `start`.
   727→        lines = [
   728→            "if (x) {\n",
   729→            "  a();\n",
   730→            "} else {\n",
   731→            "  b();\n",
   732→            "}\n",
   733→        ]
   734→        result = _find_if_chain_end(lines, 0)
   735→        # The current implementation returns start (0) for this pattern;
   736→        # fix_empty_if_chain uses apply_fixer/collapse which handles it
   737→        assert isinstance(result, int)
   738→
   739→    def test_fallback_to_start(self):
   740→        """If no braces found, returns start index."""
   741→        lines = ["if (x) doSomething();\n"]
   742→        assert _find_if_chain_end(lines, 0) == 0

   230→def item_sort_key(item: WorkQueueItem) -> tuple:
   231→    """Unified sort key: plan position first, then natural ranking.
   232→
   233→    When ``_plan_position`` is stamped (by :func:`stamp_plan_sort_keys`),
   234→    planned items sort first in plan order, then existing items by natural
   235→    ranking, then newly-discovered items by natural ranking.
   236→
   237→    When no plan fields are stamped, falls back to pure natural ranking.
   238→    """
   239→    plan_pos = item.get("_plan_position")
   240→
   241→    if plan_pos is not None:
   242→        kind = item.get("kind", "issue")
   243→        # Triage stages: even when explicitly planned, maintain the
   244→        # blocked-before-unblocked invariant for correctness.
   245→        if kind == "workflow_stage":
   246→            blocked = 1 if item.get("is_blocked") else 0
   247→            stage_idx = int(item.get("stage_index", 0))
   248→            return (_TIER_PLANNED, blocked, stage_idx, item.get("id", ""))
   249→        return (_TIER_PLANNED, 0, plan_pos, item.get("id", ""))

    39→def coerce_assessment_score(value: object) -> float | None:
    40→    """Normalize a subjective assessment score payload to a 0-100 float.
    41→
    42→    Returns ``None`` when the value cannot be interpreted as a numeric score
    43→    (e.g. bools, non-numeric strings, missing keys).
    44→    """
    45→    if is_numeric(value):
    46→        return round(max(0.0, min(100.0, float(value))), 1)
    47→    if isinstance(value, dict):
    48→        raw = value.get("score")
    49→        if not is_numeric(raw):
    50→            return None
    51→        return round(max(0.0, min(100.0, float(raw))), 1)
    52→    return None
    53→
    54→
    55→def _mark_stale_assessments_on_review_resolve(
    56→    state: StateModel,
    57→    *,
    58→    status: str,
    59→    resolved_issues: list[dict],
    60→    now: str,
    61→) -> None:
    62→    """Mark subjective assessments as stale when review issues are resolved.
    63→
    64→    The assessment score is preserved (not zeroed) — only a fresh review import
    65→    should change dimension scores.  The stale marker tells the UI to prompt
    66→    for a re-review.
    67→    """
    68→    assessments = state.get("subjective_assessments")
    69→    if not isinstance(assessments, dict) or not assessments:
    70→        return
    71→
    72→    touched_dimensions: set[str] = set()
    73→    for issue in resolved_issues:
    74→        if issue.get("detector") != "review":
    75→            continue
    76→        dimension = str(issue.get("detail", {}).get("dimension", "")).strip()
    77→        if dimension:
    78→            touched_dimensions.add(dimension)
    79→
    80→    for dimension in sorted(touched_dimensions):
    81→        if dimension not in assessments:
    82→            continue
    83→
    84→        payload = assessments.get(dimension)
    85→        if isinstance(payload, dict):
    86→            payload["needs_review_refresh"] = True
    87→            payload["refresh_reason"] = f"review_issue_{status}"
    88→            payload["stale_since"] = now
    89→        else:
    90→            assessments[dimension] = {
    91→                "score": coerce_assessment_score(payload) or 0.0,
    92→                "needs_review_refresh": True,
    93→                "refresh_reason": f"review_issue_{status}",
    94→                "stale_since": now,
    95→            }

    99→    state: StateModel, pattern: str, status_filter: str = "open"
   100→) -> list[dict]:
   101→    """Return issues matching *pattern* with the given status."""
   102→    ensure_state_defaults(state)
   103→    return [
   104→        issue
   105→        for issue_id, issue in state["issues"].items()
   106→        if not issue.get("suppressed")
   107→        if (status_filter == "all" or issue["status"] == status_filter)
   108→        and _matches_pattern(issue_id, issue, pattern)
   109→    ]
   110→
   111→
   112→def resolve_issues(
   113→    state: StateModel,
   114→    pattern: str,
   115→    status: str,
   116→    note: str | None = None,
   117→    attestation: str | None = None,
   118→) -> list[str]:
   119→    """Set issue status for matches and return affected issue IDs."""
   120→    ensure_state_defaults(state)
   121→    now = utc_now()
   122→    resolved: list[str] = []
   123→    resolved_issues: list[dict] = []
   124→    status_filter = "all" if status == "open" else "open"
   125→    for issue in match_issues(state, pattern, status_filter=status_filter):
   126→        previous_status = str(issue.get("status", "open")).strip() or "open"
   127→        if status == "open" and previous_status == "open":
   128→            continue
   129→
   130→        extra_updates: dict[str, object] = {}
   131→        if status == "wontfix":
   132→            snapshot_scan_count = int(state.get("scan_count", 0) or 0)
   133→            extra_updates["wontfix_scan_count"] = snapshot_scan_count
   134→            extra_updates["wontfix_snapshot"] = {
   135→                "captured_at": now,
   136→                "scan_count": snapshot_scan_count,
   137→                "tier": issue.get("tier"),
   138→                "confidence": issue.get("confidence"),
   139→                "detail": copy.deepcopy(issue.get("detail", {})),
   140→            }
   141→        if status == "open":
   142→            issue["reopen_count"] = int(issue.get("reopen_count", 0) or 0) + 1
   143→            issue.pop("wontfix_scan_count", None)
   144→            issue.pop("wontfix_snapshot", None)
   145→            previous_note = issue.get("note")
   146→            next_note = note if note is not None else previous_note
   147→            extra_updates["resolved_at"] = None
   148→            extra_updates["note"] = next_note
   149→            reopen_attestation = {
   150→                "kind": "manual_reopen",
   151→                "text": attestation or note,
   152→                "attested_at": now,
   153→                "scan_verified": False,
   154→            }
   155→            reopen_attestation["previous_status"] = previous_status
   156→            extra_updates["resolution_attestation"] = reopen_attestation
   157→
   158→        updates: dict[str, object] = {
   159→            "status": status,
   160→            "note": note,
   161→            "resolved_at": now,
   162→            "suppressed": False,
   163→            "suppressed_at": None,
   164→            "suppression_pattern": None,
   165→            "resolution_attestation": {
   166→                "kind": "manual",
   167→                "text": attestation,
   168→                "attested_at": now,
   169→                "scan_verified": False,
   170→            },
   171→        }
   172→        updates.update(extra_updates)
   173→        issue.update(updates)
   174→        resolved.append(issue["id"])
   175→        resolved_issues.append(issue)
   176→
   177→    _mark_stale_assessments_on_review_resolve(
   178→        state,
   179→        status=status,
   180→        resolved_issues=resolved_issues,
   181→        now=now,
   182→    )
   183→
   184→    _recompute_stats(state, scan_path=state.get("scan_path"))
   185→    validate_state_invariants(state)
   186→    return resolved
   187→

   307→        failures.add(idx)
   308→
   309→
   310→def _drain_parallel_completions(
   311→    *,
   312→    pending: set,
   313→    futures: dict,
   314→    heartbeat: float | None,
   315→    indexes: list[int],
   316→    progress_fn,
   317→    error_log_fn,
   318→    contract_cache: dict[int, str],
   319→    failures: set[int],
   320→    progress_failures: set[int],
   321→    started_at: dict[int, float],
   322→    lock: threading.Lock,
   323→    clock_fn,
   324→) -> None:
   325→    if heartbeat is None:
   326→        for future in as_completed(pending):
   327→            _complete_parallel_future(
   328→                future=future,
   329→                futures=futures,
   330→                progress_fn=progress_fn,
   331→                error_log_fn=error_log_fn,
   332→                contract_cache=contract_cache,
   333→                failures=failures,
   334→                progress_failures=progress_failures,
   335→                started_at=started_at,
   336→                lock=lock,
   337→                clock_fn=clock_fn,
   338→            )
   339→        return
   340→
   341→    while pending:
   342→        try:
   343→            future = next(as_completed(pending, timeout=heartbeat))
   344→        except FuturesTimeoutError:
   345→            _heartbeat(
   346→                pending,
   347→                futures,
   348→                started_at,
   349→                lock,
   350→                indexes,
   351→                progress_fn,
   352→                clock_fn,
   353→                error_log_fn=error_log_fn,
   354→                contract_cache=contract_cache,
   355→            )
   356→            continue
   357→        pending.discard(future)
   358→        _complete_parallel_future(
   359→            future=future,
   360→            futures=futures,
   361→            progress_fn=progress_fn,
   362→            error_log_fn=error_log_fn,
   363→            contract_cache=contract_cache,
   364→            failures=failures,
   365→            progress_failures=progress_failures,
   366→            started_at=started_at,
   367→            lock=lock,
   368→            clock_fn=clock_fn,
   369→        )
   370→
   371→
   372→def _heartbeat(
   373→    pending,
   374→    futures,
   375→    started_at,
   376→    lock,
   377→    indexes,
   378→    progress_fn,
   379→    clock_fn,
   380→    *,
   381→    error_log_fn=None,
   382→    contract_cache: dict[int, str] | None = None,
   383→):
   384→    """Build and emit a heartbeat with active/queued batch status."""
   385→    with lock:
   386→        active = sorted(futures[f] for f in pending if futures[f] in started_at)
   387→    active_set = set(active)
   388→    queued = sorted(futures[f] for f in pending if futures[f] not in active_set)
   389→    elapsed = {
   390→        idx: int(max(0.0, clock_fn() - started_at.get(idx, clock_fn())))
   391→        for idx in active
   392→    }
   393→    heartbeat_error = _emit_progress(
   394→        progress_fn,
   395→        -1,
   396→        "heartbeat",
   397→        None,
   398→        details={
   399→            "active_batches": active,
   400→            "queued_batches": queued,
   401→            "elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
   402→            "active_count": len(active),
   403→            "queued_count": len(queued),
   404→            "total_count": len(indexes),
   405→        },
   406→        contract_cache=contract_cache,
   407→    )
   408→    if heartbeat_error is not None and callable(error_log_fn):
   409→        try:
   410→            error_log_fn(-1, heartbeat_error)
   411→        except _RUNNER_CALLBACK_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   412→            log_best_effort_failure(
   413→                logger,
   414→                "record batch heartbeat failure via callback",
   415→                exc,
   416→            )
   417→
   418→
   419→__all__ = [
   420→    "_complete_parallel_future",
   421→    "_drain_parallel_completions",
   422→    "_execute_parallel",
   423→    "_execute_serial",
   424→    "_heartbeat",
   425→    "_queue_parallel_tasks",
   426→    "_resolve_parallel_runtime",
   427→    "_run_parallel_task",
   428→]

   183→def _resolve_retry_config(deps: CodexBatchRunnerDeps) -> _RetryConfig:
   184→    retries_raw = deps.max_retries if isinstance(deps.max_retries, int) else 0
   185→    max_retries = max(0, retries_raw)
   186→    max_attempts = max_retries + 1
   187→    backoff_raw = (
   188→        float(deps.retry_backoff_seconds)
   189→        if isinstance(deps.retry_backoff_seconds, int | float)
   190→        else 0.0
   191→    )
   192→    retry_backoff_seconds = max(0.0, backoff_raw)
   193→    live_log_interval = (
   194→        float(deps.live_log_interval_seconds)
   195→        if isinstance(deps.live_log_interval_seconds, int | float)
   196→        and float(deps.live_log_interval_seconds) > 0
   197→        else 5.0
   198→    )
   199→    stall_seconds = (
   200→        int(deps.stall_after_output_seconds)
   201→        if isinstance(deps.stall_after_output_seconds, int | float)
   202→        and int(deps.stall_after_output_seconds) > 0
   203→        else 0
   204→    )
   205→    use_popen = bool(deps.use_popen_runner) and callable(
   206→        getattr(deps, "subprocess_popen", None)
   207→    )
   208→    return _RetryConfig(
   209→        max_attempts=max_attempts,
   210→        retry_backoff_seconds=retry_backoff_seconds,
   211→        live_log_interval=live_log_interval,
   212→        stall_seconds=stall_seconds,
   213→        use_popen=use_popen,
   214→    )

   217→def _run_batch_attempt(
   218→    *,
   219→    cmd: list[str],
   220→    deps: CodexBatchRunnerDeps,
   221→    output_file: Path,
   222→    log_file: Path,
   223→    log_sections: list[str],
   224→    attempt: int,
   225→    max_attempts: int,
   226→    use_popen: bool,
   227→    live_log_interval: float,
   228→    stall_seconds: int,
   229→) -> tuple[str, _ExecutionResult]:
   230→    header = f"ATTEMPT {attempt}/{max_attempts}\n$ {' '.join(cmd)}"
   231→    started_monotonic = time.monotonic()
   232→    state = _RunnerState(last_stream_activity=started_monotonic)
   233→    ctx = _AttemptContext(
   234→        header=header,
   235→        started_at_iso=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
   236→        started_monotonic=started_monotonic,
   237→        output_file=output_file,
   238→        log_file=log_file,
   239→        log_sections=log_sections,
   240→        safe_write_text_fn=deps.safe_write_text_fn,
   241→    )
   242→    _write_live_snapshot(state, ctx)
   243→    if use_popen:
   244→        result = _run_via_popen(
   245→            cmd,
   246→            deps,
   247→            state,
   248→            ctx,
   249→            live_log_interval,
   250→            stall_seconds,
   251→        )
   252→    else:
   253→        result = _run_via_subprocess(cmd, deps, state, ctx, live_log_interval)
   254→    return header, result
   255→
   256→
   257→def _handle_early_attempt_return(result: _ExecutionResult) -> int | None:
   258→    return result.early_return
   259→
   260→
   261→def _handle_timeout_or_stall(
   262→    *,
   263→    header: str,
   264→    result: _ExecutionResult,
   265→    deps: CodexBatchRunnerDeps,
   266→    output_file: Path,
   267→    log_file: Path,
   268→    log_sections: list[str],
   269→    stall_seconds: int,
   270→) -> int | None:
   271→    if not result.timed_out and not result.stalled:
   272→        return None
   273→    if result.timed_out:
   274→        log_sections.append(
   275→            f"{header}\n\nTIMEOUT after {deps.timeout_seconds}s\n\n"
   276→            f"STDOUT:\n{result.stdout_text}\n\nSTDERR:\n{result.stderr_text}\n"
   277→        )
   278→    else:
   279→        log_sections.append(
   280→            f"{header}\n\nSTALL RECOVERY after {stall_seconds}s "
   281→            "of stable output and no stream activity.\n\n"
   282→            f"STDOUT:\n{result.stdout_text}\n\nSTDERR:\n{result.stderr_text}\n"
   283→        )
   284→    if _output_file_has_json_payload(output_file):
   285→        recovery_message = (
   286→            "Recovered timed-out batch from JSON output file; "
   287→            "continuing as success."
   288→            if result.timed_out
   289→            else "Recovered stalled batch from JSON output file; "
   290→            "continuing as success."
   291→        )
   292→        log_sections.append(recovery_message)
   293→        deps.safe_write_text_fn(log_file, "\n\n".join(log_sections))
   294→        return 0
   295→    deps.safe_write_text_fn(log_file, "\n\n".join(log_sections))
   296→    return 124
   297→
   298→
   299→def _handle_successful_attempt(
   300→    *,
   301→    result: _ExecutionResult,
   302→    output_file: Path,
   303→    log_file: Path,
   304→    deps: CodexBatchRunnerDeps,
   305→    log_sections: list[str],
   306→) -> int | None:
   307→    if result.code != 0:
   308→        return None
   309→    if not _output_file_has_json_payload(output_file):
   310→        log_sections.append(
   311→            "Runner exited 0 but output file is missing or invalid; "
   312→            "treating as execution failure."
   313→        )
   314→        deps.safe_write_text_fn(log_file, "\n\n".join(log_sections))
   315→        return 1
   316→    deps.safe_write_text_fn(log_file, "\n\n".join(log_sections))
   317→    return 0
   318→
   319→
   320→def _handle_failed_attempt(
   321→    *,
   322→    result: _ExecutionResult,
   323→    deps: CodexBatchRunnerDeps,
   324→    attempt: int,
   325→    max_attempts: int,
   326→    retry_backoff_seconds: float,
   327→    log_file: Path,
   328→    log_sections: list[str],
   329→) -> int | None:
   330→    combined = f"{result.stdout_text}\n{result.stderr_text}".lower()
   331→    is_transient = any(needle in combined for needle in _TRANSIENT_RUNNER_PHRASES)
   332→    if not is_transient or attempt >= max_attempts:
   333→        deps.safe_write_text_fn(log_file, "\n\n".join(log_sections))
   334→        return result.code
   335→    delay_seconds = retry_backoff_seconds * (2 ** (attempt - 1))
   336→    log_sections.append(
   337→        "Transient runner failure detected; "
   338→        f"retrying in {delay_seconds:.1f}s (attempt {attempt + 1}/{max_attempts})."
   339→    )
   340→    try:
   341→        if delay_seconds > 0:
   342→            deps.sleep_fn(delay_seconds)
   343→    except (OSError, RuntimeError, ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
   344→        log_sections.append(
   345→            f"Retry delay hook failed: {exc} — aborting remaining retries."
   346→        )
   347→        deps.safe_write_text_fn(log_file, "\n\n".join(log_sections))
   348→        return 1
   349→    return None
   350→

    14→
    15→from ._runner_process_types import _AttemptContext, _RunnerState
    16→
    17→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

    19→
    20→def _output_file_status_text(output_file: Path) -> str:
    21→    """Describe output file state for live log snapshots."""
    22→    if not output_file.exists():
    23→        return f"{output_file} (missing)"
    24→    try:
    25→        stat = output_file.stat()
    26→    except OSError as exc:
    27→        return f"{output_file} (exists; stat failed: {exc})"
    28→    modified_at = datetime.fromtimestamp(stat.st_mtime, tz=UTC).isoformat(
    29→        timespec="seconds"
    30→    )
    31→    return f"{output_file} (exists; bytes={stat.st_size}; modified={modified_at})"
    32→
    33→
    34→def _output_file_has_json_payload(output_file: Path) -> bool:
    35→    """Return True when the output file contains a valid JSON object."""
    36→    if not output_file.exists():
    37→        return False
    38→    try:
    39→        payload = json.loads(output_file.read_text())
    40→    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
    41→        return False
    42→    return isinstance(payload, dict)
    43→
    44→
    45→def _extract_payload_from_log(
    46→    batch_index: int,
    47→    raw_path: Path,
    48→    extract_fn,
    49→) -> dict[str, object] | None:
    50→    """Try to recover a batch payload from the runner log file."""
    51→    log_path = raw_path.parent.parent / "logs" / f"batch-{batch_index + 1}.log"
    52→    if not log_path.exists():
    53→        return None
    54→    try:
    55→        log_text = log_path.read_text()
    56→    except OSError:
    57→        return None
    58→
    59→    stdout_marker = "\nSTDOUT:\n"
    60→    stderr_marker = "\n\nSTDERR:\n"
    61→    stdout_start = log_text.rfind(stdout_marker)
    62→    if stdout_start == -1 and log_text.startswith("STDOUT:\n"):
    63→        stdout_start = 0
    64→        stdout_offset = len("STDOUT:\n")
    65→    elif stdout_start >= 0:
    66→        stdout_offset = len(stdout_marker)
    67→    else:
    68→        stdout_offset = 0
    69→    if stdout_start >= 0:
    70→        start_idx = stdout_start + stdout_offset
    71→        stdout_end = log_text.find(stderr_marker, start_idx)
    72→        stdout_text = (
    73→            log_text[start_idx:] if stdout_end == -1 else log_text[start_idx:stdout_end]
    74→        )
    75→        payload = extract_fn(stdout_text)
    76→        if payload is not None:
    77→            return payload
    78→        # If the batch log has a concrete STDOUT section but it contains no parseable
    79→        # payload, do not fallback to parsing the whole log. Full logs include the
    80→        # prompt template (often with JSON examples), which can hide true STDERR failures.
    81→        return None
    82→
    83→    return extract_fn(log_text)
    84→
    85→
    86→def _terminate_process(process: subprocess.Popen[str]) -> None:
    87→    """Terminate (then kill) a subprocess that may still be running."""
    88→    if process.poll() is not None:
    89→        return
    90→    try:
    91→        process.terminate()
    92→        process.wait(timeout=3)
    93→        return
    94→    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as exc:
    95→        log_best_effort_failure(
    96→            logger,
    97→            "terminate review subprocess before kill fallback",
    98→            exc,
    99→        )
   100→    try:
   101→        process.kill()
   102→        process.wait(timeout=3)
   103→    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
   104→        return
   105→
   106→
   107→def _drain_stream(stream, sink: list[str], state: _RunnerState) -> None:
   108→    """Read lines from *stream* into *sink*, updating activity timestamp."""
   109→    if stream is None:
   110→        return
   111→    try:
   112→        for chunk in iter(stream.readline, ""):
   113→            if not chunk:
   114→                break
   115→            with state.lock:
   116→                sink.append(chunk)
   117→                state.last_stream_activity = time.monotonic()
   118→    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive boundary
   119→        with state.lock:
   120→            sink.append(f"\n[stream read error: {exc}]\n")
   121→    finally:
   122→        try:
   123→            stream.close()
   124→        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
   125→            log_best_effort_failure(logger, "close review batch stream", exc)
   126→
   127→
   128→def _write_live_snapshot(state: _RunnerState, ctx: _AttemptContext) -> None:
   129→    """Write a point-in-time log snapshot while the runner is active."""
   130→    elapsed_seconds = int(max(0.0, time.monotonic() - ctx.started_monotonic))
   131→    with state.lock:
   132→        stdout_preview = "".join(state.stdout_chunks)
   133→        stderr_preview = "".join(state.stderr_chunks)
   134→        note = state.runner_note
   135→    note_block = f"\nRUNNER NOTE: {note}" if note else ""
   136→    ctx.safe_write_text_fn(
   137→        ctx.log_file,
   138→        "\n\n".join(
   139→            ctx.log_sections
   140→            + [
   141→                (
   142→                    f"{ctx.header}\n\n"
   143→                    "STATUS: running\n"
   144→                    f"STARTED AT: {ctx.started_at_iso}\n"
   145→                    f"ELAPSED: {elapsed_seconds}s\n"
   146→                    f"OUTPUT FILE: {_output_file_status_text(ctx.output_file)}"
   147→                    f"{note_block}\n\n"
   148→                    f"STDOUT (live):\n{stdout_preview}\n\n"
   149→                    f"STDERR (live):\n{stderr_preview}\n"
   150→                )
   151→            ]
   152→        ),
   153→    )
   154→
   155→
   156→def _start_live_writer(
   157→    state: _RunnerState,
   158→    ctx: _AttemptContext,
   159→    interval: float,
   160→) -> threading.Thread:
   161→    """Spawn a daemon thread that periodically writes live log snapshots."""
   162→
   163→    def _loop() -> None:
   164→        while not state.stop_event.wait(interval):
   165→            _write_live_snapshot(state, ctx)
   166→
   167→    thread = threading.Thread(target=_loop, daemon=True)
   168→    thread.start()
   169→    return thread
   170→
   171→
   172→def _check_stall(
   173→    output_file: Path,
   174→    prev_sig: tuple[int, int] | None,
   175→    prev_stable: float | None,
   176→    now: float,
   177→    last_activity: float,
   178→    threshold: int,
   179→) -> tuple[bool, tuple[int, int] | None, float | None]:
   180→    """Check for runner stall. Returns (stalled, new_sig, new_stable_since)."""
   181→    try:
   182→        stat = output_file.stat()
   183→        current_signature: tuple[int, int] | None = (
   184→            int(stat.st_size),
   185→            int(stat.st_mtime),
   186→        )
   187→    except OSError:
   188→        current_signature = None
   189→    if current_signature is None:
   190→        baseline = prev_stable if isinstance(prev_stable, int | float) else now
   191→        output_age = now - baseline
   192→        stream_idle = now - last_activity
   193→        if output_age >= threshold and stream_idle >= threshold:
   194→            return True, None, baseline
   195→        return False, None, baseline
   196→    if current_signature != prev_sig:
   197→        return False, current_signature, now
   198→    if prev_stable is None:
   199→        return False, prev_sig, prev_stable
   200→    output_age = now - prev_stable
   201→    stream_idle = now - last_activity
   202→    if output_age >= threshold and stream_idle >= threshold:
   203→        return True, prev_sig, prev_stable
   204→    return False, prev_sig, prev_stable
   205→
   206→
   207→__all__ = [
   208→    "_check_stall",
   209→    "_drain_stream",
   210→    "_extract_payload_from_log",
   211→    "_output_file_has_json_payload",
   212→    "_output_file_status_text",
   213→    "_start_live_writer",
   214→    "_terminate_process",
   215→    "_write_live_snapshot",
   216→]

    34→def _coerce_batch_execution_options(

    38→    base = options or BatchExecutionOptions(run_parallel=False)
    39→    max_parallel_workers = (

    41→        if isinstance(base.max_parallel_workers, int)

    49→        else None
    50→    )
    51→    clock_fn = base.clock_fn if callable(base.clock_fn) else time.monotonic
    52→
    53→    return BatchExecutionOptions(

    61→def _progress_contract(
    62→    progress_fn,
    63→    *,
    64→    contract_cache: dict[int, str] | None = None,
    65→) -> str:
    66→    """Resolve callback contract once: event callback or none."""
    67→    if not callable(progress_fn):
    68→        return "none"
    69→    fn_id = id(progress_fn)
    70→    cache = contract_cache if contract_cache is not None else {}
    71→    cached = cache.get(fn_id)
    72→    if cached:
    73→        return cached
    74→    contract = "event"
    75→    cache[fn_id] = contract
    76→    return contract

   379→    strategy: str | None,

   395→def _confirm_strategy_valid(strategy: str) -> bool:
   396→    if strategy.strip().lower() == "same":
   397→        return True
   398→    if len(strategy.strip()) >= 200:
   399→        return True
   400→    print(colorize(f"  Strategy too short: {len(strategy.strip())} chars (minimum 200).", "red"))
   401→    return False

   249→def _print_reflect_dashboard(si: object, plan: dict) -> None:
   250→    """Show completed clusters, resolved issues, and recurring patterns."""
   251→    # si is a TriageInput
   252→    completed = getattr(si, "completed_clusters", [])
   253→    resolved = getattr(si, "resolved_issues", {})
   254→    open_issues = getattr(si, "open_issues", {})
   255→
   256→    if completed:
   257→        print(colorize("\n  Previously completed clusters:", "cyan"))
   258→        for c in completed[:10]:
   259→            name = c.get("name", "?")
   260→            count = len(c.get("issue_ids", []))
   261→            thesis = c.get("thesis", "")
   262→            print(f"    {name}: {count} issues")
   263→            if thesis:
   264→                print(colorize(f"      {thesis}", "dim"))
   265→            for step in c.get("action_steps", [])[:3]:
   266→                print(colorize(f"      - {step}", "dim"))
   267→        if len(completed) > 10:
   268→            print(colorize(f"    ... and {len(completed) - 10} more", "dim"))
   269→
   270→    if resolved:
   271→        print(colorize(f"\n  Resolved issues since last triage: {len(resolved)}", "cyan"))
   272→        for fid, f in sorted(resolved.items())[:10]:
   273→            status = f.get("status", "")
   274→            summary = f.get("summary", "")
   275→            detail = f.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(f.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   276→            dim = detail.get("dimension", "")
   277→            print(f"    [{status}] [{dim}] {summary}")
   278→            print(colorize(f"      {fid}", "dim"))
   279→        if len(resolved) > 10:
   280→            print(colorize(f"    ... and {len(resolved) - 10} more", "dim"))
   281→
   282→    recurring = detect_recurring_patterns(open_issues, resolved)
   283→    if recurring:
   284→        print(colorize("\n  Recurring patterns detected:", "yellow"))
   285→        for dim, info in sorted(recurring.items()):
   286→            resolved_count = len(info["resolved"])
   287→            open_count = len(info["open"])
   288→            label = "potential loop" if open_count >= resolved_count else "root cause unaddressed"
   289→            print(colorize(
   290→                f"    {dim}: {resolved_count} resolved, {open_count} still open — {label}",
   291→                "yellow",
   292→            ))
   293→    elif not completed and not resolved:
   294→        print(colorize("\n  First triage — no prior work to compare against.", "dim"))
   295→        print(colorize("  Focus your reflect report on your strategy:", "yellow"))
   296→        print(colorize("  - How will you resolve contradictions you identified in observe?", "dim"))
   297→        print(colorize("  - Which issues will you cluster together vs defer?", "dim"))
   298→        print(colorize("  - What's the overall arc of work and why?", "dim"))

   300→def _cmd_triage_dashboard(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   301→    """Default view: show issues, stage progress, and next command."""
   302→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   303→    state = runtime.state
   304→    plan = load_plan()
   305→    si = collect_triage_input(plan, state)
   306→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   307→    stages = meta.get("triage_stages", {})
   308→
   309→    print(colorize("  Epic triage \u2014 manual", "bold"))
   310→    print(colorize("  " + "\u2500" * 60, "dim"))
   311→    print(f"  Open review issues: {len(si.open_issues)}")
   312→    print(colorize("  Goal: identify contradictions, resolve them, then group the coherent", "cyan"))
   313→    print(colorize("  remainder into clusters by root cause with action steps and priorities.", "cyan"))
   314→    if si.existing_epics:
   315→        print(f"  Existing epics: {len(si.existing_epics)}")
   316→    if si.new_since_last:
   317→        print(colorize(f"  New since last triage: {len(si.new_since_last)}", "yellow"))
   318→        for fid in sorted(si.new_since_last):
   319→            f = si.open_issues.get(fid, {})
   320→            dim = ""
   321→            detail = f.get("detail")
   322→            if isinstance(detail, dict):
   323→                dim = detail.get("dimension", "")
   324→            dim_tag = f" ({dim})" if dim else ""
   325→            print(colorize(f"    * [{short_issue_id(fid)}] {f.get('summary', '')}{dim_tag}", "yellow"))
   326→    if si.resolved_since_last:
   327→        print(f"  Resolved since last triage: {len(si.resolved_since_last)}")
   328→
   329→    # Stage progress (with enrichment gaps)
   330→    print()
   331→    _print_stage_progress(stages, plan)
   332→    if meta.get("stage_refresh_required"):
   333→        print(
   334→            colorize(
   335→                "  Note: review issues changed since stage progress started; "
   336→                "refresh stage reports before completion.",
   337→                "yellow",
   338→            )
   339→        )
   340→
   341→    # --- Action guidance (shown early so agents see what to do first) ---
   342→    print()
   343→    has_only_additions = bool(si.new_since_last) and not si.resolved_since_last
   344→    if "observe" not in stages and has_only_additions and meta.get("strategy_summary"):
   345→        # Show both paths: accept or re-plan
   346→        print(colorize("  Two paths available:", "yellow"))
   347→        print()
   348→        print(colorize("  To accept current queue (new items at end):", "cyan"))
   349→        print(
   350→            '    desloppify plan triage --confirm-existing '
   351→            '--note "..." --strategy "same" --confirmed "I have reviewed..."'
   352→        )
   353→        print()
   354→        print(colorize("  To re-prioritize and restructure:", "cyan"))
   355→        print(f"    {TRIAGE_CMD_OBSERVE}")
   356→    elif "observe" not in stages:
   357→        print(colorize("  Next step:", "yellow"))
   358→        print(f"    {TRIAGE_CMD_OBSERVE}")
   359→        print(colorize("    (themes, root causes, contradictions between issues — NOT a list of IDs)", "dim"))
   360→    elif "reflect" not in stages:
   361→        print(colorize("  Next step: use the completed work and patterns below to write your reflect report.", "yellow"))
   362→        print(f"    {TRIAGE_CMD_REFLECT}")
   363→        print(colorize("    (Contradictions, recurring patterns, which direction to take, what to defer)", "dim"))
   364→    elif "organize" not in stages:
   365→        gaps = _unenriched_clusters(plan)
   366→        manual = _manual_clusters_with_issues(plan)
   367→
   368→        if not manual:
   369→            print(colorize("  Next steps:", "yellow"))
   370→            print("    0. Defer contradictory issues: `desloppify plan skip <hash>`")
   371→            print(f"    1. Create clusters:  {TRIAGE_CMD_CLUSTER_CREATE}")
   372→            print(f"    2. Add issues:     {TRIAGE_CMD_CLUSTER_ADD}")
   373→            print(f"    3. Enrich clusters:  {TRIAGE_CMD_CLUSTER_STEPS}")
   374→            print(f"    4. Record stage:     {TRIAGE_CMD_ORGANIZE}")
   375→        elif gaps:
   376→            print(colorize("  Enrich these clusters before recording organize:", "yellow"))
   377→            for name, missing in gaps:
   378→                print(colorize(f"    {name}: missing {', '.join(missing)}", "yellow"))
   379→            print(colorize(
   380→                f"    Fix: {TRIAGE_CMD_CLUSTER_ENRICH_COMPACT}",
   381→                "dim",
   382→            ))
   383→            print(colorize(f"    Then: {TRIAGE_CMD_ORGANIZE}", "dim"))
   384→        else:
   385→            print(colorize("  All clusters enriched! Record the organize stage:", "green"))
   386→            print(f"    {TRIAGE_CMD_ORGANIZE}")
   387→
   388→        if meta.get("strategy_summary"):
   389→            print()
   390→            print(colorize("  Or fast-track (if existing plan is still valid):", "dim"))
   391→            print(f"    {TRIAGE_CMD_CONFIRM_EXISTING}")
   392→    else:
   393→        print(colorize("  Ready to complete:", "green"))
   394→        print(f"    {TRIAGE_CMD_COMPLETE_VERBOSE}")
   395→        print(colorize('    (use --strategy "same" to keep existing strategy)', "dim"))
   396→
   397→    # --- Prior stage reports (context for current action) ---
   398→    if "observe" in stages:
   399→        obs_report = stages["observe"].get("report", "")
   400→        if obs_report:
   401→            print(colorize("\n  Your observe analysis:", "dim"))
   402→            for line in obs_report.strip().splitlines()[:8]:
   403→                print(colorize(f"    {line}", "dim"))
   404→            if len(obs_report.strip().splitlines()) > 8:
   405→                print(colorize("    ...", "dim"))
   406→    if "reflect" in stages:
   407→        ref_report = stages["reflect"].get("report", "")

   409→            print(colorize("\n  Your reflect strategy:", "dim"))
   410→            for line in ref_report.strip().splitlines()[:8]:
   411→                print(colorize(f"    {line}", "dim"))
   412→            if len(ref_report.strip().splitlines()) > 8:
   413→                print(colorize("    ...", "dim"))
   414→
   415→    # --- Issues data ---
   416→    # Group issues by dimension with suggestions to surface contradictions
   417→    by_dim: dict[str, list[tuple[str, dict]]] = defaultdict(list)
   418→    for fid, f in si.open_issues.items():
   419→        detail = f.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(f.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   420→        dim = detail.get("dimension", "unknown")
   421→        by_dim[dim].append((fid, f))
   422→
   423→    print(colorize("\n  Review issues by dimension:", "cyan"))
   424→    print(colorize("  (Look for contradictions: issues in the same dimension that", "dim"))
   425→    print(colorize("  recommend opposite changes. These must be resolved before clustering.)", "dim"))
   426→    max_per_dim = 5
   427→    for dim in sorted(by_dim, key=lambda d: (-len(by_dim[d]), d)):
   428→        items = by_dim[dim]
   429→        print(colorize(f"\n    {dim} ({len(items)}):", "bold"))
   430→        for fid, f in items[:max_per_dim]:
   431→            summary = f.get("summary", "")

   433→            detail = f.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(f.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   434→            suggestion = (detail.get("suggestion") or "")[:120]

   438→        if len(items) > max_per_dim:
   439→            print(colorize(f"      ... and {len(items) - max_per_dim} more", "dim"))
   440→    print(colorize("\n  Use hash in commands: desloppify plan skip <hash>  |  desloppify show <hash>", "dim"))
   441→
   442→    # Show reflect dashboard when observe done, reflect not done
   443→    if "observe" in stages and "reflect" not in stages:
   444→        _print_reflect_dashboard(si, plan)
   445→
   446→    # Show current cluster progress

   449→def _show_plan_summary(plan: dict, state: dict) -> None:
   450→    """Print a compact plan rendering: clusters + queue order + coverage."""
   451→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   452→    active = {
   453→        n: c for n, c in clusters.items()
   454→        if c.get("issue_ids") and not c.get("auto")
   455→    }
   456→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
   457→
   458→    if active:
   459→        print(colorize(f"\n  Clusters ({len(active)}):", "bold"))
   460→        for name, cluster in active.items():
   461→            count = len(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
   462→            steps = len(cluster.get("action_steps", []))
   463→            desc = (cluster.get("description") or "")[:60]
   464→            print(f"    {name}: {count} items, {steps} steps — {desc}")
   465→
   466→    queue_order = [
   467→        fid for fid in plan.get("queue_order", [])
   468→        if not fid.startswith("triage::") and not fid.startswith("workflow::")
   469→    ]
   470→    if queue_order:
   471→        show = min(15, len(queue_order))
   472→        print(colorize(f"\n  Queue order (first {show} of {len(queue_order)}):", "bold"))
   473→        for i, fid in enumerate(queue_order[:show]):
   474→            f = issues.get(fid, {})
   475→            summary = (f.get("summary") or fid)[:60]
   476→            detector = f.get("detector", "?")
   477→            cn = _find_cluster_for(fid, active)
   478→            print(f"    {i+1}. [{detector}] {summary}{f' ({cn})' if cn else ''}")
   479→
   480→    organized, total, _ = _triage_coverage(
   481→        plan, open_review_ids=_open_review_ids_from_state(state),
   482→    )
   483→    pct = int(organized / total * 100) if total else 0
   484→    print(colorize(f"\n  Coverage: {organized}/{total} in clusters ({pct}%)", "bold"))
   485→
   486→__all__ = [
   487→    "_cmd_triage_dashboard",
   488→    "_print_organize_result",

   490→    "_print_reflect_dashboard",
   491→    "_print_reflect_result",
   492→    "_print_stage_progress",
   493→    "_show_plan_summary",

   208→def make_cyclomatic_complexity_compute(spec: TreeSitterLangSpec):
   209→    """Create a compute function for max cyclomatic complexity per function.
   210→
   211→    Cyclomatic complexity = 1 + number of decision points (if/for/while/case/catch/&&/||).
   212→    Returns the max CC across all functions in the file.
   213→    """
   214→    from ._extractors import _run_query, _unwrap_node
   215→
   216→    _cached_parser: dict[str, Any] = {}
   217→
   218→    def compute(content: str, lines: list[str], *, _filepath: str = "") -> tuple[int, str] | None:
   219→        if not _filepath:
   220→            return None
   221→
   222→        if not _ensure_parser(_cached_parser, spec, with_query=True):
   223→            return None
   224→
   225→        parser = _cached_parser["parser"]
   226→        query = _cached_parser["query"]
   227→
   228→        cached = _PARSE_CACHE.get_or_parse(_filepath, parser, spec.grammar)
   229→        if cached is None:
   230→            return None
   231→        _source, tree = cached
   232→
   233→        matches = _run_query(query, tree.root_node)
   234→        max_cc = 0
   235→        for _pattern_idx, captures in matches:
   236→            func_node = _unwrap_node(captures.get("func"))
   237→            if not func_node:
   238→                continue
   239→            cc = 1 + _count_decisions(func_node)
   240→            if cc > max_cc:
   241→                max_cc = cc
   242→
   243→        if max_cc <= 1:
   244→            return None
   245→        return max_cc, f"cyclomatic complexity {max_cc}"
   246→
   247→    return compute
   248→

     9→def _require_triage_pending(plan: dict, *, action: str) -> bool:
    10→    """Require at least one triage stage ID to be present in queue for an action."""
    11→    order = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
    12→    if order & TRIAGE_IDS:

    18→def _validate_stage_report(
    19→    report: str | None,
    20→    *,
    21→    stage: str,
    22→    min_chars: int,
    23→    missing_guidance: list[str] | None = None,
    24→    short_guidance: list[str] | None = None,
    25→) -> str | None:
    26→    """Validate staged report presence/length and print consistent guidance."""
    27→    if not report:
    28→        print(colorize(f"  --report is required for --stage {stage}.", "red"))
    29→        for line in missing_guidance or []:
    30→            print(colorize(f"  {line}", "dim"))
    31→        return None
    32→    cleaned = report.strip()
    33→    if len(cleaned) < min_chars:
    34→        print(
    35→            colorize(
    36→                f"  Report too short: {len(cleaned)} chars (minimum {min_chars}).",
    37→                "red",
    38→            )
    39→        )
    40→        for line in short_guidance or []:
    41→            print(colorize(f"  {line}", "dim"))
    42→        return None
    43→    return cleaned
    44→

    46→def _triage_coverage(plan: dict) -> tuple[int, int, dict]:
    47→    """Return (organized, total, clusters) for triage progress."""
    48→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
    49→    all_cluster_ids: set[str] = set()
    50→    for cluster in clusters.values():
    51→        all_cluster_ids.update(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
    52→    queue_ids = [issue_id for issue_id in plan.get("queue_order", []) if issue_id not in TRIAGE_IDS]
    53→    organized = sum(1 for issue_id in queue_ids if issue_id in all_cluster_ids)
    54→    return organized, len(queue_ids), clusters

    57→def _unenriched_clusters(plan: dict) -> list[tuple[str, list[str]]]:
    58→    """Return clusters with issues that are missing required enrichment."""
    59→    gaps: list[tuple[str, list[str]]] = []

    10→def refresh_stage_snapshot(plan: dict, state: dict) -> None:
    11→    """Mark stage progress as aligned with the current review-issue snapshot."""
    12→    meta = plan.setdefault("epic_triage_meta", {})
    13→    meta["stage_snapshot_hash"] = review_issue_snapshot_hash(state)
    14→    meta["stage_refresh_required"] = False
    15→
    16→
    17→def record_triage_stage(
    18→    plan: dict,
    19→    state: dict,
    20→    *,
    21→    stage: str,
    22→    report: str,
    23→    cited_ids: list[str],
    24→    issue_count: int,
    25→    extra: dict[str, object] | None = None,
    26→) -> dict[str, object]:
    27→    """Persist one stage payload, refresh snapshot metadata, and save the plan."""
    28→    meta = plan.setdefault("epic_triage_meta", {})
    29→    stages = meta.setdefault("triage_stages", {})
    30→    payload: dict[str, object] = {
    31→        "stage": stage,
    32→        "report": report,
    33→        "cited_ids": list(cited_ids),
    34→        "timestamp": utc_now(),
    35→        "issue_count": issue_count,
    36→    }
    37→    if extra:
    38→        payload.update(extra)
    39→    stages[stage] = payload
    40→    refresh_stage_snapshot(plan, state)
    41→    save_plan(plan)
    42→    return payload
    43→

    10→

    12→def extract_subtype(issue: dict) -> str | None:
    13→    """Extract the subtype/kind from a issue."""
    14→    detail = issue.get("detail") or {}
    15→    kind = detail.get("kind")
    16→    if kind:
    17→        return kind
    18→
    19→    issue_id = issue.get("id", "")
    20→    parts = issue_id.split("::")
    21→    if len(parts) >= 3:
    22→        candidate = parts[-1]
    23→        if "/" not in candidate and "." not in candidate:
    24→            return candidate
    25→    return None
    26→
    27→
    28→def grouping_key(issue: dict, meta: DetectorMeta | None) -> str | None:
    29→    """Compute a deterministic grouping key for a issue."""
    30→    detector = issue.get("detector", "")
    31→
    32→    if meta is None:
    33→        return f"detector::{detector}"
    34→
    35→    if detector in ("review", "subjective_review"):
    36→        detail = issue.get("detail") or {}
    37→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
    38→        if dimension:
    39→            return f"review::{dimension}"
    40→        return f"detector::{detector}"
    41→
    42→    if meta.needs_judgment and detector in ("structural", "responsibility_cohesion"):
    43→        file_path = issue.get("file", "")
    44→        if file_path:
    45→            basename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    46→            return f"file::{detector}::{basename}"
    47→
    48→    if meta.needs_judgment:
    49→        subtype = extract_subtype(issue)
    50→        if subtype:
    51→            return f"typed::{detector}::{subtype}"
    52→
    53→    if meta.action_type == "auto_fix" and not meta.needs_judgment:
    54→        return f"auto::{detector}"
    55→
    56→    return f"detector::{detector}"
    57→
    58→
    59→def cluster_name_from_key(key: str) -> str:
    60→    """Convert a grouping key to an ``auto/...`` cluster name."""
    61→    parts = key.split("::")
    62→    if len(parts) == 2:
    63→        prefix_type = parts[0]
    64→        if prefix_type == "review":
    65→            return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}review-{parts[1]}"
    66→        return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}{parts[1]}"
    67→    if len(parts) == 3:
    68→        return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}{parts[1]}-{parts[2]}"
    69→    return f"{AUTO_PREFIX}{key.replace('::', '-')}"

    83→    if detector in ("review", "subjective_review"):

    85→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", detector)

    92→        return f"Decompose {count} large files"

   100→        return f"Remove {count} {display} issues"

   106→    """Check if a subtype maps to a detector fixer."""

   107→            result.epics_created += 1

   109→    # --- Dismiss issues ---------------------------------------------------
   110→    dismissed_ids: list[str] = []
   111→    for df in triage.dismissed_issues:
   112→        fid = df.issue_id
   113→        dismissed_ids.append(fid)
   114→        # Remove from queue, add to skipped as triaged_out
   115→        if fid in order:
   116→            order.remove(fid)
   117→        skipped[fid] = {
   118→            "issue_id": fid,
   119→            "kind": "triaged_out",
   120→            "reason": df.reason,
   121→            "note": f"Dismissed by epic triage v{version}",
   122→            "attestation": None,
   123→            "created_at": now,
   124→            "review_after": None,
   125→            "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
   126→        }
   127→        result.issues_dismissed += 1
   128→
   129→    # Also handle per-epic dismissed lists
   130→    for epic_data in triage.epics:
   131→        for fid in epic_data.get("dismissed", []):
   132→            if fid not in dismissed_ids and fid in order:
   133→                order.remove(fid)
   134→                dismissed_ids.append(fid)
   135→                skipped[fid] = {
   136→                    "issue_id": fid,
   137→                    "kind": "triaged_out",
   138→                    "reason": f"Dismissed by epic triage v{version}",
   139→                    "note": None,
   140→                    "attestation": None,
   141→                    "created_at": now,
   142→                    "review_after": None,
   143→                    "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
   144→                }
   145→                result.issues_dismissed += 1
   146→
   147→    # --- Reorder queue: epic issues grouped by dependency_order -----------
   148→    epic_issue_ids: set[str] = set()
   149→    epic_ordered_ids: list[str] = []
   150→    for epic_data in sorted(triage.epics, key=lambda e: e.get("dependency_order", 999)):
   151→        for fid in epic_data["issue_ids"]:
   152→            if fid not in epic_issue_ids and fid not in dismissed_ids:
   153→                epic_issue_ids.add(fid)
   154→                epic_ordered_ids.append(fid)
   155→
   156→    # Rebuild order: epic items first (by dependency), then non-epic items in original order
   157→    non_epic_items = [fid for fid in order if fid not in epic_issue_ids]
   158→    # Insert epic items at the front.
   159→    new_order: list[str] = []
   160→    new_order.extend(epic_ordered_ids)
   161→    new_order.extend(non_epic_items)
   162→    order.clear()
   163→    order.extend(new_order)
   164→
   165→    # --- Update triage meta -----------------------------------------------
   166→    current_hash = review_issue_snapshot_hash(state)
   167→    open_review_ids = sorted(
   168→        fid for fid, f in state.get("issues", {}).items()
   169→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   170→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   171→    )
   172→
   173→    plan["epic_triage_meta"] = {
   174→        "triaged_ids": open_review_ids,
   175→        "last_run": now,
   176→        "version": version,
   177→        "dismissed_ids": dismissed_ids,
   178→        "issue_snapshot_hash": current_hash,
   179→        "strategy_summary": triage.strategy_summary,
   180→        "trigger": trigger,
   181→    }
   182→    plan["updated"] = now
   183→
   184→    return result
   185→
   186→__all__ = ["TriageMutationResult", "apply_triage_to_plan"]
   187→

1→"""Parsing helpers for epic triage output."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import re
     6→
     7→from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import VALID_EPIC_DIRECTIONS
     8→
     9→from .epic_triage_prompt import ContradictionNote, DismissedIssue, TriageResult
    10→
    11→ISSUE_ID_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z_]+::[a-f0-9]{8,}")
    12→
    13→def extract_issue_citations(text: str, valid_ids: set[str]) -> set[str]:
    14→    """Extract issue IDs cited in free text.
    15→
    16→    Matches full issue IDs (e.g. ``review::abcdef12``) or bare 8+ char
    17→    hex suffixes that correspond to a known issue.
    18→    """
    19→    cited: set[str] = set()
    20→    # Match full issue IDs
    21→    for match in ISSUE_ID_RE.finditer(text):
    22→        candidate = match.group()
    23→        if candidate in valid_ids:
    24→            cited.add(candidate)
    25→    # Match 8+ char hex suffixes
    26→    for token in re.findall(r"[0-9a-f]{8,}", text):
    27→        for valid_id in valid_ids:
    28→            if valid_id.endswith("::" + token):
    29→                cited.add(valid_id)
    30→                break
    31→    return cited
    32→
    33→def parse_triage_result(raw: dict, valid_ids: set[str]) -> TriageResult:
    34→    """Parse and validate raw LLM output into a TriageResult.
    35→
    36→    Invalid issue IDs are silently dropped from epics and dismissals.
    37→    """
    38→    strategy_summary = str(raw.get("strategy_summary", ""))
    39→
    40→    epics: list[dict] = []
    41→    for raw_epic in raw.get("epics", []):
    42→        if not isinstance(raw_epic, dict):
    43→            continue
    44→        name = str(raw_epic.get("name", "")).strip()
    45→        if not name:
    46→            continue
    47→        # Validate direction
    48→        direction = str(raw_epic.get("direction", "simplify")).strip()
    49→        if direction not in VALID_EPIC_DIRECTIONS:
    50→            direction = "simplify"
    51→        # Filter to valid issue IDs
    52→        issue_ids = [
    53→            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("issue_ids", [])
    54→            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
    55→        ]
    56→        dismissed = [
    57→            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("dismissed", [])
    58→            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
    59→        ]
    60→        action_steps = [
    61→            str(s) for s in raw_epic.get("action_steps", [])
    62→            if isinstance(s, str)
    63→        ]
    64→
    65→        epics.append({
    66→            "name": name,
    67→            "thesis": str(raw_epic.get("thesis", "")),
    68→            "direction": direction,
    69→            "root_cause": str(raw_epic.get("root_cause", "")),
    70→            "issue_ids": issue_ids,
    71→            "dismissed": dismissed,
    72→            "agent_safe": bool(raw_epic.get("agent_safe", False)),
    73→            "dependency_order": int(raw_epic.get("dependency_order", 999)),
    74→            "action_steps": action_steps,
    75→            "status": str(raw_epic.get("status", "pending")),
    76→        })
    77→
    78→    dismissed_issues: list[DismissedIssue] = []
    79→    for d in raw.get("dismissed_issues", []):
    80→        if not isinstance(d, dict):
    81→            continue
    82→        fid = str(d.get("issue_id", ""))
    83→        if fid in valid_ids:
    84→            dismissed_issues.append(
    85→                DismissedIssue(issue_id=fid, reason=str(d.get("reason", "")))
    86→            )
    87→
    88→    contradiction_notes: list[ContradictionNote] = []
    89→    for c in raw.get("contradiction_notes", []):
    90→        if not isinstance(c, dict):
    91→            continue
    92→        contradiction_notes.append(ContradictionNote(
    93→            kept=str(c.get("kept", "")),
    94→            dismissed=str(c.get("dismissed", "")),
    95→            reason=str(c.get("reason", "")),
    96→        ))
    97→
    98→    priority_rationale = str(raw.get("priority_rationale", ""))
    99→
   100→    return TriageResult(
   101→        strategy_summary=strategy_summary,
   102→        epics=epics,
   103→        dismissed_issues=dismissed_issues,
   104→        contradiction_notes=contradiction_notes,
   105→        priority_rationale=priority_rationale,
   106→    )
   107→
   108→__all__ = ["ISSUE_ID_RE", "extract_issue_citations", "parse_triage_result"]

    54→    contradiction_notes: list[ContradictionNote] = field(default_factory=list)
    55→    priority_rationale: str = ""
    56→
    57→def collect_triage_input(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> TriageInput:
    58→    """Gather all data needed for the triage LLM prompt."""
    59→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
    60→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
    61→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
    62→    epics = triage_clusters(plan)
    63→
    64→    open_review: dict[str, dict] = {}
    65→    open_mechanical: dict[str, dict] = {}
    66→    for fid, f in issues.items():
    67→        if f.get("status") != "open":
    68→            continue
    69→        if f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns"):
    70→            open_review[fid] = f
    71→        else:
    72→            open_mechanical[fid] = f
    73→
    74→    triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
    75→    current_review_ids = set(open_review.keys())
    76→    new_since = current_review_ids - triaged_ids
    77→    resolved_since = triaged_ids - current_review_ids
    78→    previously_dismissed = list(meta.get("dismissed_ids", []))
    79→    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
    80→
    81→    # Resolved issue objects (for REFLECT stage)
    82→    resolved_issue_objs = {
    83→        fid: issues[fid] for fid in resolved_since if fid in issues
    84→    }
    85→
    86→    # Completed clusters since last triage completion
    87→    last_completed = meta.get("last_completed_at", "")
    88→    all_completed: list[dict] = plan.get("completed_clusters", [])
    89→    if last_completed:
    90→        recent_completed = [
    91→            c for c in all_completed
    92→            if c.get("completed_at", "") > last_completed
    93→        ]
    94→    else:
    95→        recent_completed = list(all_completed)
    96→
    97→    return TriageInput(
    98→        open_issues=open_review,
    99→        mechanical_issues=open_mechanical,
   100→        existing_epics=dict(epics),
   101→        dimension_scores=state.get("dimension_scores", {}),
   102→        new_since_last=new_since,
   103→        resolved_since_last=resolved_since,
   104→        previously_dismissed=previously_dismissed,
   105→        triage_version=version,
   106→        resolved_issues=resolved_issue_objs,
   107→        completed_clusters=recent_completed,
   108→    )
   109→
   110→_TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """\
   111→You are maintaining the meta-plan for this codebase. Your goal is to produce
   112→a coherent, prioritized strategy to address ALL open review issues.
   113→
   114→Your plan should:
   115→- Cluster issues by ROOT CAUSE, not by dimension or detector
   116→- Give each cluster (epic) a clear thesis: one imperative sentence
   117→- Order epics by dependency: what must be done first for later work to make sense
   118→- Dismiss issues that don't make sense, are contradictory, or are false positives
   119→- Mark which epics are agent-safe (can be executed mechanically) vs need human judgment
   120→- Avoid creating work that contradicts other work in the plan
   121→- Be ambitious but realistic — aim to resolve all issues coherently
   122→
   123→Available directions for epics: delete, merge, flatten, enforce, simplify, decompose, extract, inline.
   124→
   125→Available plan tools (the agent executing your plan has access to these):
   126→- `desloppify plan queue` — view all items in priority order
   127→- `desloppify plan focus epic/<name>` — focus the queue on one epic
   128→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --permanent --note "why" --attest "..."` — permanently dismiss
   129→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --note "revisit later"` — temporarily defer
   130→- `desloppify plan resolve <id> --note "what I did" --attest "..."` — mark resolved
   131→- `desloppify plan reorder <id> top|bottom|before|after <target>` — reorder
   132→- `desloppify plan cluster show <name>` — inspect a cluster
   133→- `desloppify scan` — re-scan after making changes to verify progress
   134→- `desloppify show review --status open` — see all open review issues
   135→
   136→Your output defines the ENTIRE work plan. Issues not assigned to any epic
   137→will remain in the queue as individual items. Dismissed issues will be
   138→removed from the queue with your stated reason.
   139→
   140→Respond with a single JSON object matching this schema:
   141→{
   142→  "strategy_summary": "2-4 sentence narrative: what the meta-plan says, top priorities, current state",
   143→  "epics": [
   144→    {
   145→      "name": "slug-name",
   146→      "thesis": "imperative one-liner",
   147→      "direction": "delete|merge|flatten|enforce|simplify|decompose|extract|inline",
   148→      "root_cause": "why this cluster exists",
   149→      "issue_ids": ["id1", "id2"],
   150→      "dismissed": ["id3"],
   151→      "agent_safe": true,
   152→      "dependency_order": 1,
   153→      "action_steps": ["step 1", "step 2"],
   154→      "status": "pending"
   155→    }
   156→  ],
   157→  "dismissed_issues": [
   158→    {"issue_id": "id", "reason": "why this issue doesn't make sense"}
   159→  ],
   160→  "contradiction_notes": [
   161→    {"kept": "issue_id", "dismissed": "issue_id", "reason": "why"}
   162→  ],
   163→  "priority_rationale": "why the dependency_order is what it is"
   164→}
   165→"""
   166→
   167→def build_triage_prompt(si: TriageInput) -> str:
   168→    """Build the user-facing prompt content with all issue data."""
   169→    parts: list[str] = []
   170→
   171→    # Section: existing epics
   172→    if si.existing_epics:
   173→        parts.append("## Existing Epics (update these, don't recreate)")
   174→        for name, epic in sorted(si.existing_epics.items()):
   175→            status = epic.get("status", "pending")
   176→            thesis = epic.get("thesis", "")
   177→            direction = epic.get("direction", "")
   178→            fids = epic.get("issue_ids", [])
   179→            parts.append(
   180→                f"- {name} [{status}] ({direction}): {thesis}"
   181→                f"\n  Issues: {', '.join(fids[:10])}"
   182→                f"{'...' if len(fids) > 10 else ''}"
   183→            )
   184→        parts.append("")
   185→
   186→    # Section: what changed
   187→    if si.new_since_last:
   188→        parts.append(f"## New issues since last triage ({len(si.new_since_last)})")
   189→        for fid in sorted(si.new_since_last):
   190→            f = si.open_issues.get(fid, {})
   191→            parts.append(f"- {fid}: {f.get('summary', '(no summary)')}")
   192→        parts.append("")
   193→
   194→    if si.resolved_since_last:
   195→        parts.append(f"## Resolved since last triage ({len(si.resolved_since_last)})")
   196→        for fid in sorted(si.resolved_since_last):
   197→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   198→        parts.append("")
   199→
   200→    # Section: all open review issues
   201→    parts.append(f"## All open review issues ({len(si.open_issues)})")
   202→    for fid, f in sorted(si.open_issues.items()):
   203→        detail = f.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(f.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   204→        suggestion = detail.get("suggestion", "")
   205→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
   206→        confidence = f.get("confidence", "medium")
   207→        file_path = f.get("file", "")
   208→        summary = f.get("summary", "")
   209→        parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {fid}")
   210→        parts.append(f"  File: {file_path}")
   211→        if dimension:
   212→            parts.append(f"  Dimension: {dimension}")
   213→        parts.append(f"  Summary: {summary}")
   214→        if suggestion:
   215→            parts.append(f"  Suggestion: {suggestion}")
   216→    parts.append("")
   217→
   218→    # Section: dimension scores for context
   219→    if si.dimension_scores:
   220→        parts.append("## Dimension scores (context)")
   221→        for name, data in sorted(si.dimension_scores.items()):
   222→            if isinstance(data, dict):
   223→                score = data.get("score", "?")
   224→                strict = data.get("strict", score)
   225→                issues = data.get("failing", 0)
   226→                parts.append(f"- {name}: {score}% (strict: {strict}%, {issues} issues)")
   227→        parts.append("")
   228→
   229→    # Section: previously dismissed
   230→    if si.previously_dismissed:
   231→        parts.append(f"## Previously dismissed ({len(si.previously_dismissed)})")
   232→        parts.append("Maintain unless contradicted by new evidence.")
   233→        for fid in si.previously_dismissed:
   234→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   235→        parts.append("")
   236→
   237→    return "\n".join(parts)
   238→
   239→__all__ = [
   240→    "_TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT",
   241→    "ContradictionNote",
   242→    "DismissedIssue",
   243→    "TriageInput",
   244→    "TriageResult",
   245→    "build_triage_prompt",
   246→    "collect_triage_input",

    15→def current_stale_ids(
    16→    state: StateModel,
    17→    *,
    18→    subjective_prefix: str = "subjective::",
    19→) -> set[str]:

    29→        dim_key = entry.get("dimension_key", "")
    30→        if dim_key:
    31→            stale.add(f"{subjective_prefix}{slugify(dim_key)}")

    58→    for data in dim_scores.values():
    59→        if not isinstance(data, dict):

    61→        detectors = data.get("detectors", {})
    62→        meta = detectors.get("subjective_assessment")
    63→        if not isinstance(meta, dict):

    73→def current_under_target_ids(
    74→    state: StateModel,
    75→    *,
    76→    target_strict: float = DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE,
    77→    subjective_prefix: str = "subjective::",
    78→) -> set[str]:
    79→    """Return under-target subjective IDs that are neither stale nor unscored."""
    80→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}

    83→

    86→
    87→    under_target: set[str] = set()
    88→    for entry in all_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores):
    89→        if entry.get("placeholder") or entry.get("stale"):
    90→            continue
    91→        strict_val = float(entry.get("strict", entry.get("score", 100.0)))
    92→        if strict_val >= target_strict:

    94→        dim_key = entry.get("dimension_key", "")
    95→        if not dim_key:

    97→        item_id = f"{subjective_prefix}{slugify(dim_key)}"
    98→        if item_id not in stale_ids and item_id not in unscored_ids:
    99→            under_target.add(item_id)

   103→def review_issue_snapshot_hash(state: StateModel) -> str:
   104→    """Hash open review/concerns issue IDs to detect triage-relevant changes."""
   105→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
   106→    review_ids = sorted(
   107→        issue_id
   108→        for issue_id, issue in issues.items()
   109→        if issue.get("status") == "open" and issue.get("detector") in _REVIEW_DETECTORS
   110→    )
   111→    if not review_ids:
   112→        return ""
   113→    return hashlib.sha256("|".join(review_ids).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
   114→

   116→def compute_new_issue_ids(plan: dict, state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
   117→    """Return open review/concerns IDs that appeared since the last triage."""
   118→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   119→    triaged = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", meta.get("synthesized_ids", [])))
   120→    current = {
   121→        issue_id
   122→        for issue_id, issue in state.get("issues", {}).items()
   123→        if issue.get("status") == "open" and issue.get("detector") in _REVIEW_DETECTORS
   124→    }
   125→    return current - triaged if triaged else set()
   126→
   127→
   128→def is_triage_stale(
   129→    plan: dict,
   130→    state: StateModel,
   131→    *,
   132→    triage_ids: set[str] | frozenset[str] = frozenset(),
   133→) -> bool:
   134→    """Return True when triage should run because review work has changed."""
   135→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   136→
   137→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
   138→    current_review_ids = {
   139→        issue_id
   140→        for issue_id, issue in issues.items()
   141→        if issue.get("status") == "open" and issue.get("detector") in _REVIEW_DETECTORS
   142→    }
   143→    triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   144→    new_since_triage = current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   145→    if new_since_triage:
   146→        return True
   147→
   148→    confirmed = set(meta.get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   149→    if confirmed:
   150→        order = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   151→        if order & set(triage_ids):
   152→            return True
   153→    return False
   154→

1→"""State-backed work queue for review issues.
     2→
     3→Review issues live in state["issues"]. This module provides:
     4→- Listing/sorting open review issues by impact
     5→- Storing investigation notes on issues
     6→- Expiring stale holistic issues during scan
     7→"""
     8→
     9→from __future__ import annotations
    10→
    11→import logging
    12→from datetime import UTC, datetime
    13→
    14→from desloppify.base.output.issues import issue_weight
    15→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import detail_dict
    16→
    17→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    18→
    19→__all__ = [
    20→    "impact_label",
    21→    "list_open_review_issues",
    22→    "update_investigation",
    23→    "expire_stale_holistic",
    24→]
    25→
    26→
    27→def impact_label(weight: float) -> str:
    28→    """Convert weight to a human-readable impact label."""
    29→    try:
    30→        numeric = float(weight)
    31→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
    32→        return "+"
    33→    if numeric >= 8:
    34→        return "+++"
    35→    if numeric >= 5:
    36→        return "++"
    37→    return "+"
    38→
    39→
    40→def list_open_review_issues(state: dict) -> list[dict]:
    41→    """Return open review issues sorted by impact (highest first)."""
    42→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
    43→    review = [
    44→        issue
    45→        for issue in issues.values()
    46→        if issue.get("status") == "open" and issue.get("detector") == "review"
    47→    ]
    48→
    49→    def _sort_key(issue: dict) -> tuple[float, str]:
    50→        weight, _impact, issue_id = issue_weight(issue)
    51→        return (-weight, issue_id)
    52→
    53→    review.sort(key=_sort_key)
    54→    return review
    55→
    56→
    57→def update_investigation(state: dict, issue_id: str, text: str) -> bool:
    58→    """Store investigation text on a issue. Returns False if not found/not open."""
    59→    issue = state.get("issues", {}).get(issue_id)
    60→    if not issue or issue.get("status") != "open":
    61→        return False
    62→    detail = detail_dict(issue)
    63→    if not detail:
    64→        detail = {}
    65→        issue["detail"] = detail
    66→    detail["investigation"] = text
    67→    detail["investigated_at"] = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
    68→    return True
    69→
    70→
    71→def expire_stale_holistic(state: dict, max_age_days: int = 30) -> list[str]:
    72→    """Auto-resolve holistic review issues older than max_age_days."""
    73→    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    74→    expired: list[str] = []
    75→
    76→    for issue_id, issue in state.get("issues", {}).items():
    77→        if issue.get("detector") != "review":
    78→            continue
    79→        if issue.get("status") != "open":
    80→            continue
    81→        if not detail_dict(issue).get("holistic"):
    82→            continue
    83→
    84→        last_seen = issue.get("last_seen")
    85→        if not last_seen:
    86→            continue
    87→
    88→        try:
    89→            seen_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(last_seen)
    90→        except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
    91→            logger.debug(
    92→                "Skipping holistic issue %s with invalid last_seen %r: %s",
    93→                issue_id,
    94→                last_seen,
    95→                exc,
    96→            )
    97→            continue
    98→
    99→        age_days = (now - seen_dt).days
   100→        if age_days > max_age_days:
   101→            issue["status"] = "auto_resolved"
   102→            issue["resolved_at"] = now.isoformat()
   103→            issue["note"] = "holistic review expired — re-run review to re-evaluate"
   104→            expired.append(issue_id)
   105→
   106→    return expired
   107→

    20→def make_ast_smells_phase(spec) -> DetectorPhase:

    23→    def run(path, lang):
