   269→
   270→def sync_triage_needed(
   271→    plan: PlanModel,
   272→    state: StateModel,
   273→) -> TriageSyncResult:
   274→    """Inject 4 triage stage IDs at front of queue when review issues change.
   275→
   276→    Only injects stages not already confirmed in ``epic_triage_meta``.
   277→
   278→    When stages are already present but all new issues have been resolved
   279→    since injection, auto-prunes the stale stages and updates the hash.
   280→
   281→    When issues are *resolved* (current IDs are a subset of previously
   282→    triaged IDs), the snapshot hash is updated silently — no re-triage
   283→    is needed since the user is working through the plan.
   284→    """
   285→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   286→    result = TriageSyncResult()
   287→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   288→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   289→    confirmed = set(meta.get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   290→
   291→    # Check if any triage stage is already in queue
   292→    already_present = any(sid in order for sid in TRIAGE_IDS)
   293→
   294→    current_hash = review_issue_snapshot_hash(state)
   295→    last_hash = meta.get("issue_snapshot_hash", "")
   296→
   297→    if already_present:
   298→        # Stages present — check if the reason for injection still applies.
   299→        # Only auto-prune when triage was completed before (hash exists),
   300→        # all new issues have been resolved, and no triage work is in
   301→        # progress.  This avoids pruning the initial triage or a
   302→        # user-started triage session.
   303→        if last_hash and not confirmed:
   304→            issues = state.get("issues", {})
   305→            current_review_ids = {
   306→                fid for fid, f in issues.items()
   307→                if f.get("status") == "open"
   308→                and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   309→            }
   310→            triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   311→            new_since_triage = current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   312→
   313→            if not new_since_triage:
   314→                # No new issues remain — prune stale stages
   315→                for sid in TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS:
   316→                    while sid in order:
   317→                        order.remove(sid)
   318→                if current_hash:
   319→                    meta["issue_snapshot_hash"] = current_hash
   320→                    plan["epic_triage_meta"] = meta
   321→                result.pruned = True
   322→        return result
   323→
   324→    if current_hash and current_hash != last_hash:
   325→        # Distinguish "new issues appeared" from "issues were resolved".
   326→        # Only re-triage when genuinely new issues exist.
   327→        issues = state.get("issues", {})
   328→        current_review_ids = {
   329→            fid for fid, f in issues.items()
   330→            if f.get("status") == "open"
   331→            and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   332→        }
   333→        triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   334→        new_since_triage = current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   335→
   336→        if new_since_triage:
   337→            # New review issues appeared — re-triage needed
   338→            insert_at = promoted_insertion_index(order, plan)
   339→            stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   340→            existing = set(order)
   341→            injected_count = 0
   342→            for sid, name in zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names, strict=False):
   343→                if name not in confirmed and sid not in existing:
   344→                    order.insert(insert_at + injected_count, sid)
   345→                    injected_count += 1
   346→            if injected_count:
   347→                result.injected = True
   348→        else:
   349→            # Only resolved issues changed the hash — update silently
   350→            meta["issue_snapshot_hash"] = current_hash
   351→            plan["epic_triage_meta"] = meta
   352→
   353→    return result
   354→
   355→
   356→@dataclass
   357→class ScoreCheckpointSyncResult:
   358→    """What changed during a score-checkpoint sync."""
   359→
   360→    injected: bool = False
   361→
   362→    @property
   363→    def changes(self) -> int:
   364→        return int(self.injected)
   365→
   366→
   367→def sync_score_checkpoint_needed(
   368→    plan: PlanModel,
   369→    state: StateModel,
   370→    *,
   371→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   372→) -> ScoreCheckpointSyncResult:
   373→    """Inject ``workflow::score-checkpoint`` when all initial reviews complete.
   374→
   375→    Injects when:
   376→    - No unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions remain
   377→    - ``workflow::score-checkpoint`` is not already in the queue
   378→
   379→    Positioned after subjective items but before triage/create-plan
   380→    so the user sees their updated strict score right after reviews finish.
   381→    """
   382→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   383→    result = ScoreCheckpointSyncResult()
   384→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   385→
   386→    if WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID in order:
   387→        return result
   388→
   389→    # Check that no unscored dimensions remain
   390→    if policy is not None:
   391→        if policy.unscored_ids:
   392→            return result
   393→    else:
   394→        unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   395→        if unscored:
   396→            return result
   397→
   398→    # Insert after any subjective items, before triage/workflow/issues
   399→    insert_at = 0
   400→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   401→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX):
   402→            insert_at = i + 1
   403→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID)
   404→    result.injected = True
   405→    return result
   406→
   407→
   408→@dataclass
   409→class CreatePlanSyncResult:
   410→    """What changed during a create-plan sync."""
   411→
   412→    injected: bool = False
   413→
   414→    @property
   415→    def changes(self) -> int:
   416→        return int(self.injected)
   417→
   418→
   419→def sync_create_plan_needed(
   420→    plan: PlanModel,
   421→    state: StateModel,
   422→    *,
   423→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   424→) -> CreatePlanSyncResult:
   425→    """Inject ``workflow::create-plan`` when reviews complete + objective backlog exists.
   426→
   427→    Only injects when:
   428→    - No unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions remain
   429→    - At least one objective issue exists
   430→    - ``workflow::create-plan`` is not already in the queue
   431→    - No triage stages are pending
   432→    """
   433→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   434→    result = CreatePlanSyncResult()
   435→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   436→
   437→    if WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID in order:
   438→        return result
   439→
   440→    # Don't inject if triage stages are pending
   441→    if any(sid in order for sid in TRIAGE_IDS):
   442→        return result
   443→
   444→    # Check that no unscored dimensions remain
   445→    if policy is not None:
   446→        if policy.unscored_ids:
   447→            return result
   448→        has_objective = policy.has_objective_backlog
   449→    else:
   450→        unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   451→        if unscored:
   452→            return result
   453→        issues = state.get("issues", {})
   454→        has_objective = any(
   455→            f.get("status") == "open"
   456→            and f.get("detector") not in _NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   457→            for f in issues.values()
   458→        )
   459→    if not has_objective:
   460→        return result
   461→
   462→    # Insert after any subjective/workflow items, at the end of the
   463→    # synthetic block (so create-plan comes after score-checkpoint).
   464→    insert_at = 0
   465→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   466→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(TRIAGE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(WORKFLOW_PREFIX):
   467→            insert_at = i + 1
   468→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID)
   469→    result.injected = True
   470→    return result
   471→
   472→
   473→def compute_new_issue_ids(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
   474→    """Return the set of open review/concerns issue IDs added since last triage.
   475→
   476→    Returns an empty set when no prior triage has recorded ``triaged_ids``.
   477→    """
   478→    return stale_policy_mod.compute_new_issue_ids(plan, state)
   479→
   480→
   481→def is_triage_stale(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> bool:
   482→    """Side-effect-free check: is triage needed?
   483→
   484→    Returns True when genuinely *new* review issues appeared since the
   485→    last triage.  Triage stage IDs being in the queue alone is not
   486→    sufficient — the new issues that triggered injection may have been
   487→    resolved since then.
   488→
   489→    When issues are merely resolved (current IDs are a subset of
   490→    previously triaged IDs), triage is NOT stale — the user is working
   491→    through the plan.
   492→    """
   493→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   494→    return stale_policy_mod.is_triage_stale(plan, state, triage_ids=TRIAGE_IDS)
   495→
   496→
   497→@dataclass
   498→class ImportScoresSyncResult:
   499→    """What changed during an import-scores sync."""
   500→
   501→    injected: bool = False
   502→
   503→    @property
   504→    def changes(self) -> int:
   505→        return int(self.injected)
   506→
   507→
   508→def sync_import_scores_needed(
   509→    plan: PlanModel,
   510→    state: StateModel,
   511→    *,
   512→    assessment_mode: str | None = None,
   513→) -> ImportScoresSyncResult:
   514→    """Inject ``workflow::import-scores`` after issues-only import.
   515→
   516→    Only injects when:
   517→    - Assessment mode was ``issues_only`` (scores were skipped)
   518→    - ``workflow::import-scores`` is not already in the queue
   519→    - There are assessments in the payload that could be imported
   520→
   521→    Positioned after score-checkpoint, before create-plan.
   522→    """
   523→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   524→    result = ImportScoresSyncResult()
   525→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   526→
   527→    if WORKFLOW_IMPORT_SCORES_ID in order:
   528→        return result
   529→
   530→    # Only inject when scores were skipped (issues-only mode)
   531→    if assessment_mode != "issues_only":
   532→        return result
   533→
   534→    # Insert after any subjective/workflow items
   535→    insert_at = 0
   536→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   537→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(WORKFLOW_PREFIX):
   538→            insert_at = i + 1
   539→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_IMPORT_SCORES_ID)
   540→    result.injected = True
   541→    return result
   542→
   543→
   544→@dataclass
   545→class CommunicateScoreSyncResult:
   546→    """What changed during a communicate-score sync."""
   547→
   548→    injected: bool = False
   549→
   550→    @property
   551→    def changes(self) -> int:
   552→        return int(self.injected)
   553→
   554→
   555→def sync_communicate_score_needed(
   556→    plan: PlanModel,
   557→    state: StateModel,
   558→    *,
   559→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   560→    scores_just_imported: bool = False,
   561→) -> CommunicateScoreSyncResult:
   562→    """Inject ``workflow::communicate-score`` when scores should be shown.
   563→
   564→    Injects when either:
   565→    - All initial subjective reviews are complete (no unscored dimensions), OR
   566→    - Scores were just imported (trusted/attested/override)
   567→
   568→    And ``workflow::communicate-score`` is not already in the queue.
   569→    Positioned after subjective items but before triage/create-plan.
   570→    """
   571→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   572→    result = CommunicateScoreSyncResult()
   573→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   574→
   575→    # Also treat legacy score-checkpoint as already-present
   576→    if WORKFLOW_COMMUNICATE_SCORE_ID in order or WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID in order:
   577→        return result
   578→
   579→    # Trigger 1: scores just imported
   580→    should_inject = scores_just_imported
   581→
   582→    # Trigger 2: all initial reviews complete (no unscored dimensions)
   583→    if not should_inject:
   584→        if policy is not None:
   585→            should_inject = not policy.unscored_ids
   586→        else:
   587→            should_inject = not current_unscored_ids(state)
   588→
   589→    if not should_inject:
   590→        return result
   591→
   592→    # Insert after any subjective items, before triage/workflow/issues
   593→    insert_at = 0
   594→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   595→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX):
   596→            insert_at = i + 1
   597→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_COMMUNICATE_SCORE_ID)
   598→    result.injected = True
   599→    return result
   600→

   381→def test_subjective_threshold_clamped_to_valid_range():
   382→    """Threshold values outside [0, 100] are clamped, not rejected."""
   383→    state = _state(
   384→        [],
   385→        dimension_scores={
   386→            "Naming quality": {"score": 50.0, "strict": 50.0, "failing": 1, "stale": True},
   387→        },

   389→    # threshold=-10 clamps to 0.0 -> score 50 >= 0 -> item excluded
   390→    queue = build_work_queue(
   391→        state, count=None, include_subjective=True, subjective_threshold=-10
   392→    )
   393→    subj_items = [item for item in queue["items"] if item["kind"] == "subjective_dimension"]
   394→    assert subj_items == []
   395→
   396→    # threshold=200 clamps to 100.0 -> score 50 < 100 -> item included
   397→    queue2 = build_work_queue(
   398→        state, count=None, include_subjective=True, subjective_threshold=200
   399→    )
   400→    subj_items2 = [item for item in queue2["items"] if item["kind"] == "subjective_dimension"]
   401→    assert len(subj_items2) >= 1

   638→# ── Impact-based ordering ──────────────────────────────────
   639→
   640→
   641→def test_high_impact_subjective_before_low_impact_mechanical():
   642→    """A subjective dimension with high headroom sorts before a mechanical
   643→    issue in a near-perfect dimension."""
   644→    from desloppify.engine._work_queue.ranking import enrich_with_impact, item_sort_key
   645→
   646→    subj_item = {
   647→        "id": "subjective::naming",
   648→        "kind": "subjective_dimension",
   649→        "detail": {"dimension_name": "Naming quality", "strict_score": 43.0},
   650→        "confidence": "medium",
   651→    }
   652→    mech_item = {
   653→        "id": "smells::src/a.py::x",
   654→        "kind": "issue",
   655→        "detector": "smells",
   656→        "confidence": "high",
   657→        "detail": {"count": 1},
   658→    }
   659→
   660→    dimension_scores = {
   661→        "Naming quality": {
   662→            "score": 43.0,
   663→            "strict": 43.0,
   664→            "failing": 3,
   665→            "detectors": {
   666→                "subjective_assessment": {"dimension_key": "naming_quality"},
   667→            },
   668→        },
   669→        "Code quality": {
   670→            "score": 97.0,
   671→            "strict": 97.0,
   672→            "checks": 200,
   673→            "failing": 1,
   674→            "detectors": {
   675→                "smells": {"weighted_failures": 1, "potential": 200},
   676→            },
   677→        },
   678→    }
   679→
   680→    enrich_with_impact([subj_item, mech_item], dimension_scores)
   681→
   682→    # Naming quality has much more headroom (57) than Code quality (3)
   683→    assert subj_item["estimated_impact"] > mech_item["estimated_impact"]
   684→    assert item_sort_key(subj_item) < item_sort_key(mech_item)
   685→
   686→
   687→def test_impact_fallback_when_no_dimension_scores():
   688→    """When no dimension_scores exist, all items get impact 0.0 and
   689→    tiebreakers provide default ordering."""

   691→
   692→    items = [

   707→    ]
   708→
   709→    enrich_with_impact(items, {})
   710→
   711→    assert all(item["estimated_impact"] == 0.0 for item in items)
   712→    # High confidence sorts before medium when impact is equal

   832→# ── Cluster collapse ─────────────────────────────────────

   835→def test_collapse_clusters_preserves_order():
   836→    """Cluster meta-item appears at position of first member, not re-sorted."""
   837→    from desloppify.engine._work_queue.plan_order import collapse_clusters
   838→
   839→    plan: dict = {
   840→        "queue_order": [],
   841→        "skipped": {},
   842→        "overrides": {},
   843→        "clusters": {},
   844→        "active_cluster": None,
   845→    }
   846→    plan["clusters"]["auto/unused"] = {
   847→        "name": "auto/unused",
   848→        "auto": True,
   849→        "cluster_key": "auto::unused",
   850→        "issue_ids": ["u1", "u2"],
   851→        "description": "Remove 2 unused issues",
   852→        "action": "desloppify autofix unused-imports --dry-run",
   853→        "user_modified": False,
   854→    }
   855→
   856→    # Place a non-cluster item first, then the two cluster members
   857→    items = [
   858→        {"id": "other", "kind": "issue", "detector": "structural",
   859→         "confidence": "medium", "detail": {}},
   860→        {"id": "u1", "kind": "issue", "detector": "unused",
   861→         "confidence": "high", "detail": {}, "estimated_impact": 1.0},
   862→        {"id": "u2", "kind": "issue", "detector": "unused",
   863→         "confidence": "high", "detail": {}, "estimated_impact": 1.0},
   864→    ]
   865→
   866→    result = collapse_clusters(items, plan)
   867→    # Non-cluster item stays at position 0
   868→    assert result[0]["id"] == "other"
   869→    # Cluster meta-item appears at position 1 (where first member was)
   870→    assert result[1]["kind"] == "cluster"
   871→    assert result[1]["id"] == "auto/unused"
   872→    assert len(result) == 2  # other + cluster

   878→def test_plan_ordered_stale_subjective_surfaces_with_objective_backlog():

   880→    even when the plan explicitly includes them in queue_order.
   881→    They wait until the objective queue is fully drained.
   882→    """

   884→
   885→    objective_issues = [

   887→        for c in "abcd"

   889→    state = _state(

   891→        dimension_scores={

   894→                "strict": 70.0,
   895→                "failing": 1,
   896→                "detectors": {

   902→    state["subjective_assessments"] = {

   906→            "stale_since": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
   907→        }

   912→    subj_no_plan = [

   914→    ]

   916→
   917→    # With plan that includes the stale dim in queue_order: still gated

   931→    ]

    41→def enrich_with_impact(
    42→    items: list[WorkQueueItem], dimension_scores: dict[str, Any]
    43→) -> None:
    44→    """Stamp ``estimated_impact`` on each item based on dimension-level headroom.
    45→
    46→    Impact = ``overall_per_point * headroom`` where headroom = ``100 - score``.
    47→    Items in dimensions with more score headroom sort first.
    48→    """
    49→    if not dimension_scores:
    50→        for item in items:
    51→            item["estimated_impact"] = 0.0
    52→        return
    53→
    54→    breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dimension_scores)
    55→    entries = breakdown.get("entries", [])
    56→
    57→    # Build lookup: normalized dimension name -> {per_point, headroom}
    58→    dim_impact: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
    59→    for entry in entries:
    60→        name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
    61→        if not name:
    62→            continue
    63→        per_point = float(entry.get("overall_per_point", 0.0))
    64→        score = float(entry.get("score", 0.0))
    65→        headroom = 100.0 - score
    66→        dim_impact[name.lower()] = {"per_point": per_point, "headroom": headroom}
    67→
    68→    for item in items:
    69→        impact = _compute_item_impact(item, dim_impact, get_dimension_for_detector)
    70→        item["estimated_impact"] = impact
    71→
    72→
    73→def _compute_item_impact(
    74→    item: WorkQueueItem,
    75→    dim_impact: dict[str, dict[str, float]],
    76→    get_dimension_for_detector,
    77→) -> float:
    78→    """Compute impact value for a single queue item."""
    79→    kind = item.get("kind", "issue")
    80→
    81→    # Subjective items (synthetic dimensions or subjective issues):
    82→    # look up by detail.dimension_name
    83→    if kind == "subjective_dimension" or item.get("is_subjective"):
    84→        dim_name = detail_dict(item).get("dimension_name", "")
    85→        entry = dim_impact.get(dim_name.lower())
    86→        if entry:
    87→            return entry["per_point"] * entry["headroom"]
    88→        return 0.0
    89→
    90→    # Mechanical issues: use detector -> dimension mapping
    91→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
    92→    if detector:
    93→        dimension = get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
    94→        if dimension:
    95→            entry = dim_impact.get(dimension.name.lower())
    96→            if entry:
    97→                return entry["per_point"] * entry["headroom"]
    98→
    99→    return 0.0
   100→

   102→def subjective_score_value(item: WorkQueueItem) -> float:
   103→    raw_score: Any
   104→    if item.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension":
   105→        detail = detail_dict(item)
   106→        raw_score = detail.get("strict_score", item.get("subjective_score", 100.0))
   107→    else:
   108→        raw_score = item.get("subjective_score", 100.0)
   109→    if raw_score is None:
   110→        return 100.0
   111→    try:
   112→        return float(raw_score)
   113→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
   114→        return 100.0

   178→def _natural_sort_key(item: WorkQueueItem) -> tuple:
   179→    """Compute natural (non-plan-aware) ranking for queue items."""
   180→    kind = item.get("kind", "issue")
   181→
   182→    # Initial-review subjective items: highest priority
   183→    if kind == "subjective_dimension" and item.get("initial_review"):
   184→        return (_RANK_INITIAL_REVIEW, 0, subjective_score_value(item), item.get("id", ""))
   185→
   186→    # Triage stage items: stage order, blocked after unblocked
   187→    if kind == "workflow_stage":
   188→        blocked_penalty = 1 if item.get("is_blocked") else 0
   189→        stage_index = int(item.get("stage_index", 0))
   190→        return (_RANK_TRIAGE_STAGE, blocked_penalty, stage_index, item.get("id", ""))
   191→
   192→    # Workflow action items (e.g. create-plan)
   193→    if kind == "workflow_action":
   194→        return (_RANK_WORKFLOW, 0, 0, item.get("id", ""))
   195→
   196→    if kind == "cluster":
   197→        # Clusters sort before individual issues, ordered by action type
   198→        action_pri = ACTION_TYPE_PRIORITY.get(
   199→            item.get("action_type", "manual_fix"), 3
   200→        )
   201→        return (
   202→            _RANK_CLUSTER,
   203→            action_pri,
   204→            -int(item.get("member_count", 0)),
   205→            item.get("id", ""),
   206→        )
   207→
   208→    impact = item.get("estimated_impact", 0.0)
   209→
   210→    if kind == "subjective_dimension" or item.get("is_subjective"):
   211→        return (
   212→            _RANK_ISSUE,
   213→            -impact,
   214→            subjective_score_value(item),
   215→            item.get("id", ""),
   216→        )
   217→
   218→    detail = detail_dict(item)
   219→    review_weight = float(item.get("review_weight", 0.0) or 0.0)
   220→    return (
   221→        _RANK_ISSUE,
   222→        -impact,
   223→        CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(item.get("confidence", "low"), 9),
   224→        -review_weight,
   225→        -int(detail.get("count", 0) or 0),

   229→
   230→def item_sort_key(item: WorkQueueItem) -> tuple:
   231→    """Unified sort key: plan position first, then natural ranking.
   232→
   233→    When ``_plan_position`` is stamped (by :func:`stamp_plan_sort_keys`),
   234→    planned items sort first in plan order, then existing items by natural
   235→    ranking, then newly-discovered items by natural ranking.
   236→
   237→    When no plan fields are stamped, falls back to pure natural ranking.
   238→    """
   239→    plan_pos = item.get("_plan_position")
   240→
   241→    if plan_pos is not None:
   242→        kind = item.get("kind", "issue")
   243→        # Triage stages: even when explicitly planned, maintain the
   244→        # blocked-before-unblocked invariant for correctness.
   245→        if kind == "workflow_stage":
   246→            blocked = 1 if item.get("is_blocked") else 0
   247→            stage_idx = int(item.get("stage_index", 0))
   248→            return (_TIER_PLANNED, blocked, stage_idx, item.get("id", ""))
   249→        return (_TIER_PLANNED, 0, plan_pos, item.get("id", ""))
   250→
   251→    is_new = item.get("_is_new", False)
   252→    group = _TIER_NEW if is_new else _TIER_EXISTING
   253→    return (group, *_natural_sort_key(item))

   337→        total = len(cluster_data.get("issue_ids", []))
   338→        print(colorize(f"\n  Focused on: {cluster_name} ({len(items)} of {total} remaining)", "cyan"))

   342→        return
   343→
   344→    # Detect cluster drill-in: multiple items with cluster focus active

## Architecture Report: Subjective Dimension Visibility Gating

I've completed a thorough exploration of the subjective dimension visibility gating system. Here's what I found:

---

### 1. **`build_subjective_items` in `synthetic.py` (Lines 223-318)**

**What it does:**
- Builds synthetic work queue items for subjective dimensions that are below the threshold (lines 225-230: threshold filtering)
- Computes metadata about each dimension's review state (lines 235-250: count open review issues by dimension)

**Metadata fields set:**
- `initial_review` (line 314): Boolean, set to `is_unassessed` (True if dimension is never-scored/placeholder or score=0 with no failing items)
- `stale_review` (line 315): Boolean, set to `is_stale and not is_unassessed` (True if dimension marked as needing refresh, but not initial)
- `open_review_issues` in detail (line 308): Count of open review issues for this dimension
- Plus: `strict_score`, `failing`, `cli_keys` in detail dict

**Current usage status:**
- These fields ARE consumed downstream (see section 5 below)
- The logic is correct: categorizes dimensions into three states (unassessed/initial, stale, normal)

---

### 2. **`_gather_subjective_items` in `core.py` (Lines 176-228)**

**What filtering does it apply:**
- **Status gate** (lines 185-186): Returns empty list if status != "open" or "all"
- **Chronic gate** (lines 187-188): Returns empty list if `chronic=True`
- **Early return on objective backlog** (lines 213-218): **THIS IS THE KEY GATE** — if `open_objective_count > 0`, return empty list immediately. This prevents non-initial-review subjective items from surfacing while mechanical work remains
- **Policy-based gating** (lines 225-226): For each candidate item, calls `policy.should_surface(item)` before including it

**How SubjectiveVisibility policy works:**
- `should_surface()` (lines 34-41 in `subjective_policy.py`):
  - If `item["initial_review"]` is True, always return True (unscored dimensions surface unconditionally)
  - Otherwise, return True only if `has_objective_backlog` is False
  - **This means initial-review items bypass the objective count check**

**How plan_queue_set override works:**
- Line 203-206: Builds set of IDs from `plan["queue_order"]`
- Line 225: Checks `if not policy.should_surface(item) and item_id not in plan_queue_set`
- **If a subjective item is in queue_order but would be gated by policy, it is still FILTERED OUT** (plan does NOT override this)
- This appears intentional — the comment on lines 209-211 explains: subjective items don't surface while objective queue is drained, even if explicitly planned

**The new `open_objective_count` early return:**
- Lines 213-218: Counts open issues where `detector != "review"`
- If count > 0, returns empty list (short-circuits everything)
- This is **redundant with the objective_count check in the policy** — it's a performance optimization to avoid building candidates when they'll all be filtered anyway

---

### 3. **`SubjectiveVisibility` and `compute_subjective_visibility` in `subjective_policy.py`**

**The dataclass** (lines 24-65):
- Immutable snapshot with:
  - `has_objective_backlog`: boolean (objective_count > 0)
  - `objective_count`: integer for logging/debugging
  - `unscored_ids`, `stale_ids`, `under_target_ids`: frozensets of subjective IDs

**`should_surface()` method** (lines 34-41):
```python
def should_surface(self, item: dict) -> bool:
    if item.get("initial_review"):
        return True
    return not self.has_objective_backlog
```
- **NOT redundant** with the objective count gate in `_gather_subjective_items`
- This method checks the item's specific `initial_review` flag
- The `_gather_subjective_items` early return is a bulk optimization
- When called, this would give the same result, but it's cheaper to fail-fast with the objective_count

**`compute_subjective_visibility` function** (lines 82-140):
- Counts objective issues (lines 114-128): only issues where status="open", detector not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS, not suppressed, not evidence-only, in scan scope
- Calls three stale_policy helpers to get ID sets (lines 130-132)
- Returns frozen dataclass

**Redundancy check:**
- `should_surface()` is NOT fully redundant with the early return
- However, the early return in `_gather_subjective_items` (lines 217-218) means `should_surface()` is only called on items when `open_objective_count == 0`
- At that point, `should_surface()` only checks `initial_review` flag (the second branch is impossible)
- **So in practice, the policy is only used for debugging/plan injection logic, not for filtering the queue**

---

### 4. **`sync_stale_dimensions` in `stale_dimensions.py` (Lines 162-243)**

**How it injects subjective items into queue_order:**

Two injection strategies:
1. **Mid-cycle** (no objective backlog): append to back of queue (lines 237-241)
2. **Post-cycle** (cycle just completed): insert after promoted items at front (lines 228-235)

**Conditional injection** (lines 199-210):
- Computes `has_real_items` (objective backlog check)
- `should_inject = not has_real_items or cycle_just_completed`
- If should_inject=False AND items are in queue, they're evicted (lines 212-224)

**When it runs:**
- Called from `engine/plan.py` after `reconcile_plan()`
- Runs after scan save in `scan_workflow.py` → `apply_reconciliation()`
- This is **data mutation** (modifying plan.queue_order), not filtering

**Integration with policy:**
- Takes optional `policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None` parameter
- If policy provided, uses `policy.has_objective_backlog` (line 201)
- Otherwise, counts issues manually (lines 203-208)
- This policy parameter is computed once in `scan_workflow.py` and reused across multiple sync functions for efficiency

---

### 5. **Consumers of metadata fields**

**`initial_review` field:**
- **`_natural_sort_key()` in `ranking.py` (lines 182-184)**: Initial-review items get rank `-3` (highest priority), sorted by subjective_score
- **`item_explain()` in `ranking.py` (lines 286-297)**: Explains ranking policy for initial-review items
- **`should_surface()` in `subjective_policy.py` (line 39)**: Check if should bypass objective backlog gate
- **Tests in `test_subjective_policy.py` (lines 170-189)**: Verify policy logic

**`stale_review` field:**
- **Set but never consumed anywhere** — appears in types.py as part of the contract, but no code reads it
- Used only in test assertions in `work_queue_cases.py` and `test_epic_triage_apply.py`

**`open_review_issues` field:**
- **`_render_subjective_dimension()` in `next/render.py`**: NOT actually rendered — the field is set in detail dict but never read in the terminal rendering
- **Tests only**: `work_queue_cases.py` lines 237, 279 check the detail field

**Summary:**
- `initial_review`: **actively consumed** (sorting, policy, plan injection)
- `stale_review`: **dead code** — never read, only set and tested
- `open_review_issues`: **dead code** — never read or rendered, only set and tested

> DEVELOPER

Design a refactor to make the subjective dimension visibility gating in desloppify beautifully engineered. The current code has the decision "should this subjective item appear in the work queue?" scattered across multiple layers. The user wants it properly engineered — clean, simple, one clear responsibility per component.

## Current Architecture (messy)

The decision is spread across:

1. **`build_subjective_items`** in `synthetic.py` (lines 223-318) — generates candidates. Sets metadata fields `initial_review`, `stale_review`, `open_review_issues`. The `stale_review` and `open_review_issues` fields are **dead code** (never read by any consumer). Also computes `review_open_by_dim` which is used for the `primary_command` field (whether to show review issues or suggest a new review).

2. **`_gather_subjective_items`** in `core.py` (lines 176-228) — has an `open_objective_count > 0` early return that blocks ALL subjective items while there's mechanical work. Then applies SubjectiveVisibility policy per-item. Then applies plan_queue_set override.

3. **`SubjectiveVisibility`** dataclass in `subjective_policy.py` — has a `should_surface()` method that checks `initial_review` flag and `has_objective_backlog`. But the early return in `_gather_subjective_items` means `should_surface()` is only ever called when `open_objective_count == 0`, at which point `has_objective_backlog` is always False, so `should_surface()` always returns True. **The policy is effectively dead for queue filtering.**

4. **`sync_stale_dimensions`** in `stale_dimensions.py` — injects/evicts subjective IDs from `plan.queue_order`. This is plan mutation (separate concern from queue filtering). It uses SubjectiveVisibility for its own injection decisions.

5. **`compute_subjective_visibility`** — creates the policy snapshot. Used by both queue filtering and plan sync. Has a more nuanced objective count (excludes suppressed, evidence-only, out-of-scope). The `_gather_subjective_items` early return uses a simpler count (just `detector != "review"`).

## Key Facts

- `initial_review` field: actively consumed by ranking.py (sort priority), subjective_policy.py (should_surface), and plan injection
- `stale_review` field: **dead code** — set but never read by any consumer
- `open_review_issues` field: **dead code** — set in detail dict but never rendered or used
- `SubjectiveVisibility.should_surface()`: effectively dead for queue filtering (always True when called), but the dataclass IS used by `sync_stale_dimensions` for plan mutation decisions
- Plan `queue_order` override: the code has a `plan_queue_set` mechanism but the early return prevents it from ever overriding for subjective items

## Design Goals

1. **One place decides** if subjective items appear in the queue. Not three.
2. **Dead code removed** — `stale_review`, `open_review_issues` fields gone
3. **Each function has one job** — `build_subjective_items` builds candidates, `_gather_subjective_items` gates them
4. **The objective count check should be consistent** — use the same logic everywhere (currently two different counting methods)
5. **`SubjectiveVisibility`** should either be used properly or removed from the queue path
6. **Plan sync** (`sync_stale_dimensions`) is a separate concern and should stay separate — it's about plan persistence, not queue display

## Files to modify

- `desloppify/engine/_work_queue/synthetic.py` — `build_subjective_items`
- `desloppify/engine/_work_queue/core.py` — `_gather_subjective_items`
- `desloppify/engine/_plan/subjective_policy.py` — `SubjectiveVisibility`, `compute_subjective_visibility`
- `desloppify/engine/_work_queue/types.py` — WorkQueueItem type (if `stale_review` is there)
- `desloppify/engine/_work_queue/ranking.py` — consumes `initial_review`
- `desloppify/tests/review/work_queue_cases.py` — test updates
- `desloppify/tests/plan/test_subjective_policy.py` — test updates

## Constraints

- All 4248 existing tests must pass
- `sync_stale_dimensions` must continue working (it's plan mutation, separate concern)
- `initial_review` must stay (actively consumed for sort priority)
- The queue must show zero subjective items while there are objective items open
- When the queue is drained, subjective items must appear sorted by priority

   217→        "primary_command": 'desloppify plan resolve "workflow::create-plan" --note "Plan reviewed and queue organized" --confirm',
   218→        "blocked_by": [],
   219→        "is_blocked": False,

   223→def build_subjective_items(
   224→    state: dict, issues: dict, *, threshold: float = 100.0
   225→) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
   226→    """Create synthetic subjective work items."""
   227→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
   228→    if not dim_scores:
   229→        return []
   230→    threshold = max(0.0, min(100.0, float(threshold)))
   231→
   232→    subjective_entries = all_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores)
   233→    if not subjective_entries:
   234→        return []
   235→    unassessed_dims = {
   236→        str(name).strip()
   237→        for name in unassessed_subjective_dimensions(
   238→            dim_scores
   239→        )
   240→    }
   241→
   242→    # Review issues are keyed by raw dimension name (snake_case).
   243→    review_open_by_dim: dict[str, int] = {}
   244→    for issue in issues.values():
   245→        if issue.get("status") != "open":
   246→            continue
   247→        if issue.get("detector") == "review":
   248→            dim_key = str(detail_dict(issue).get("dimension", "")).strip().lower()
   249→            if dim_key:
   250→                review_open_by_dim[dim_key] = review_open_by_dim.get(dim_key, 0) + 1
   251→
   252→    items: list[WorkQueueItem] = []
   253→    def _prepare_command(
   254→        cli_keys: list[str],
   255→        *,
   256→        force_review_rerun: bool = False,
   257→    ) -> str:
   258→        command = "desloppify review --prepare"
   259→        if cli_keys:
   260→            command += " --dimensions " + ",".join(cli_keys)
   261→        if force_review_rerun:
   262→            command += " --force-review-rerun"
   263→        return command
   264→
   265→    for entry in subjective_entries:
   266→        name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
   267→        if not name:
   268→            continue
   269→        strict_val = float(entry.get("strict", entry.get("score", 100.0)))
   270→        if strict_val >= threshold:
   271→            continue
   272→
   273→        [REDACTED](name)
   274→        aliases = set(_subjective_dimension_aliases(name))
   275→        cli_keys = [
   276→            str(key).strip().lower()
   277→            for key in entry.get("cli_keys", [])
   278→            if str(key).strip()
   279→        ]
   280→        aliases.update(cli_keys)
   281→        aliases.update(slugify(key) for key in cli_keys)
   282→        open_review = sum(review_open_by_dim.get(alias, 0) for alias in aliases)
   283→        is_unassessed = bool(entry.get("placeholder")) or (
   284→            name in unassessed_dims
   285→            or (strict_val <= 0.0 and int(entry.get("failing", 0)) == 0)
   286→        )
   287→        is_stale = bool(entry.get("stale"))
   288→        # If review issues already exist for this dimension, triage/fix them
   289→        # before suggesting another review refresh pass.
   290→        if open_review > 0:
   291→            primary_command = "desloppify show review --status open"
   292→        else:
   293→            primary_command = _prepare_command(cli_keys)
   294→        stale_tag = " [stale — re-review]" if is_stale else ""
   295→        summary = f"Subjective dimension below target: {name} ({strict_val:.1f}%){stale_tag}"
   296→        items.append(
   297→            {
   298→                "id": f"subjective::{slugify(dim_key)}",
   299→                "detector": "subjective_assessment",
   300→                "file": ".",
   301→                "confidence": "medium",
   302→                "summary": summary,
   303→                "detail": {
   304→                    "dimension_name": name,
   305→                    "dimension": dim_key,
   306→                    "failing": int(entry.get("failing", 0)),
   307→                    "strict_score": strict_val,
   308→                    "open_review_issues": open_review,
   309→                    "cli_keys": cli_keys,
   310→                },
   311→                "status": "open",
   312→                "kind": "subjective_dimension",
   313→                "primary_command": primary_command,
   314→                "initial_review": is_unassessed,
   315→                "stale_review": is_stale and not is_unassessed,
   316→            }
   317→        )
   318→    return items
   319→

    94→def build_work_queue(

    98→) -> WorkQueueResult:
    99→    """Build a ranked work queue from state issues.
   100→
   101→    Pipeline:
   102→    1. Gather — issue items, subjective dimensions, workflow stages
   103→    2. Score  — estimate impact from dimension headroom, apply floor
   104→    3. Order  — stamp plan positions, sort, filter to cluster focus
   105→    4. Limit  — truncate to count, optionally add explain metadata
   106→    """
   107→    opts = options or QueueBuildOptions()
   108→    plan, scan_path, status, threshold = _resolve_inputs(opts, state)
   109→
   110→    # 1. Gather
   111→    items = build_issue_items(
   112→        state, scan_path=scan_path, status_filter=status,
   113→        scope=opts.scope, chronic=opts.chronic,
   114→    )
   115→    items += _gather_subjective_items(state, opts, plan, threshold)
   116→    items += _gather_workflow_items(state, plan, status)
   117→
   118→    # 2. Score & filter
   119→    enrich_with_impact(items, state.get("dimension_scores", {}))
   120→    items = [i for i in items if _passes_impact_floor(i)]
   121→
   122→    # 3. Plan-aware ordering
   123→    new_ids, skipped = _plan_presort(items, state, plan)
   124→    items.sort(key=item_sort_key)
   125→    _plan_postsort(items, skipped, plan, opts)
   126→
   127→    # 4. Finalize
   128→    if not items:
   129→        items += _empty_queue_fallback(plan)
   130→    total = len(items)
   131→    if opts.count is not None and opts.count > 0:
   132→        items = items[:opts.count]
   133→    if opts.explain:
   134→        for item in items:
   135→            item["explain"] = item_explain(item)
   136→
   137→    return {
   138→        "items": items,
   139→        "total": total,
   140→        "grouped": group_queue_items(items, "item"),
   141→        "new_ids": new_ids,
   142→    }
   143→

   147→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   148→
   149→
   150→def _resolve_inputs(
   151→    opts: QueueBuildOptions, state: StateModel,
   152→) -> tuple[dict | None, str | None, str, float]:
   153→    """Resolve plan, scan_path, status, and subjective threshold from options."""
   154→    ctx = opts.context
   155→    plan = ctx.plan if ctx is not None else opts.plan
   156→
   157→    scan_path: str | None = (
   158→        state.get("scan_path")
   159→        if opts.scan_path is _SCAN_PATH_FROM_STATE
   160→        else opts.scan_path  # type: ignore[assignment]
   161→    )
   162→
   163→    status = opts.status
   164→    if status not in ALL_STATUSES:
   165→        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported status filter: {status}")
   166→
   167→    try:
   168→        threshold = float(opts.subjective_threshold)
   169→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
   170→        threshold = 100.0
   171→    threshold = max(0.0, min(100.0, threshold))
   172→
   173→    return plan, scan_path, status, threshold

   176→def _gather_subjective_items(
   177→    state: StateModel,
   178→    opts: QueueBuildOptions,
   179→    plan: dict | None,
   180→    threshold: float,
   181→) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
   182→    """Build synthetic subjective items, gated by SubjectiveVisibility policy."""
   183→    if not opts.include_subjective:
   184→        return []
   185→    if opts.status not in {"open", "all"}:
   186→        return []
   187→    if opts.chronic:
   188→        return []
   189→
   190→    ctx = opts.context
   191→    policy = (
   192→        (ctx.policy if ctx is not None else None)
   193→        or opts.policy
   194→        or compute_subjective_visibility(state, plan=plan)
   195→    )
   196→
   197→    candidates = build_subjective_items(
   198→        state, state.get("issues", {}), threshold=threshold,
   199→    )
   200→
   201→    # When a plan explicitly includes a subjective item in queue_order,
   202→    # surface it regardless of policy — the plan is authoritative.
   203→    plan_queue_set: set[str] = (
   204→        set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   205→        if plan
   206→        else set()
   207→    )
   208→
   209→    # Subjective items only surface when the objective queue is drained.
   210→    # Review issues for each dimension are already separate queue items —
   211→    # the subjective meta-item adds no value while there's mechanical work.
   212→    issues = state.get("issues", {})

   214→        1 for iss in issues.values()
   215→        if iss.get("status") == "open" and iss.get("detector") != "review"
   216→    )
   217→    if open_objective_count > 0:

   225→        if not policy.should_surface(item) and item_id not in plan_queue_set:
   226→            continue
   227→        result.append(item)
   228→    return result

1→"""Unified subjective-visibility policy.
     2→
     3→A single frozen dataclass computed once per operation replaces the scattered
     4→``has_objective_items`` / ``objective_count`` computations in
     5→``stale_dimensions``, ``auto_cluster``, and ``_work_queue/core``.
     6→"""
     7→
     8→from __future__ import annotations
     9→
    10→from dataclasses import dataclass
    11→
    12→from desloppify.base.config import DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE
    13→from desloppify.base.registry import DETECTORS
    14→from desloppify.engine._state.filtering import issue_in_scan_scope
    15→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel
    16→from desloppify.engine.planning.helpers import CONFIDENCE_ORDER
    17→
    18→# Detectors whose issues are NOT objective mechanical work.
    19→NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({
    20→    "review", "concerns", "subjective_review", "subjective_assessment",
    21→})
    22→
    23→
    24→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    25→class SubjectiveVisibility:
    26→    """Immutable snapshot of the subjective-vs-objective balance."""
    27→
    28→    has_objective_backlog: bool  # any open non-subjective issues?
    29→    objective_count: int  # how many
    30→    unscored_ids: frozenset[str]  # subjective::* IDs needing initial review
    31→    stale_ids: frozenset[str]  # subjective::* IDs needing re-review
    32→    under_target_ids: frozenset[str]  # below target, not stale/unscored
    33→
    34→    def should_surface(self, item: dict) -> bool:
    35→        """Should this subjective queue item appear in the work queue?
    36→
    37→        Unscored (initial_review) -> always.  All others -> only when drained.
    38→        """
    39→        if item.get("initial_review"):
    40→            return True
    41→        return not self.has_objective_backlog
    42→
    43→    def should_inject_to_plan(self, fid: str) -> bool:
    44→        """Should this subjective ID be injected into plan queue_order?"""
    45→        if fid in self.unscored_ids:
    46→            return True  # unconditional
    47→        if fid in self.stale_ids:
    48→            return not self.has_objective_backlog
    49→        if fid in self.under_target_ids:
    50→            return not self.has_objective_backlog
    51→        return False
    52→
    53→    def should_evict_from_plan(self, fid: str) -> bool:
    54→        """Should this subjective ID be removed from plan queue_order?"""
    55→        if fid in self.unscored_ids:
    56→            return False  # never evict unscored
    57→        if fid in self.stale_ids or fid in self.under_target_ids:
    58→            return self.has_objective_backlog
    59→        return False
    60→
    61→    @property
    62→    def backlog_blocks_rerun(self) -> bool:
    63→        """Preflight: should reruns be blocked?"""
    64→        return self.has_objective_backlog
    65→
    66→
    67→def _is_evidence_only(issue: dict) -> bool:
    68→    """Return True if the issue is below its detector's standalone threshold."""
    69→    detector = issue.get("detector", "")
    70→    meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
    71→    if meta and meta.standalone_threshold:
    72→        threshold_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(meta.standalone_threshold, 9)
    73→        issue_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(issue.get("confidence", "low"), 9)
    74→        if issue_rank > threshold_rank:
    75→            return True
    76→    return False
    77→
    78→
    79→_SCAN_PATH_FROM_STATE_POLICY = object()
    80→
    81→
    82→def compute_subjective_visibility(
    83→    state: StateModel,
    84→    *,
    85→    target_strict: float = DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE,
    86→    scan_path: str | None | object = _SCAN_PATH_FROM_STATE_POLICY,
    87→    plan: dict | None = None,
    88→) -> SubjectiveVisibility:
    89→    """Build the policy snapshot from current state.
    90→
    91→    *scan_path* defaults to ``state["scan_path"]`` so callers don't need to
    92→    thread it manually.  Pass an explicit ``str`` to override, or ``None``
    93→    to disable scope filtering.  When *plan* is set, issues whose IDs
    94→    appear in ``plan["skipped"]`` are excluded.
    95→
    96→    Imports policy helpers from ``stale_policy`` so this module remains
    97→    side-effect free and cycle-safe.
    98→    """
    99→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_policy import (
   100→        current_stale_ids,
   101→        current_under_target_ids,
   102→        current_unscored_ids,
   103→    )
   104→
   105→    resolved_scan_path: str | None = (
   106→        state.get("scan_path")
   107→        if scan_path is _SCAN_PATH_FROM_STATE_POLICY
   108→        else scan_path  # type: ignore[assignment]
   109→    )
   110→
   111→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
   112→    skipped_ids = set((plan or {}).get("skipped", {}).keys())
   113→
   114→    # Count open, non-suppressed, objective issues.
   115→    # Evidence-only issues (below standalone confidence threshold) are
   116→    # excluded — they still affect scores but are not actionable queue items.
   117→    # Issues outside scan_path and plan-skipped issues are also excluded
   118→    # so the policy matches what the user actually sees in the queue.
   119→    objective_count = sum(
   120→        1
   121→        for fid, f in issues.items()
   122→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   123→        and f.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   124→        and not f.get("suppressed")
   125→        and not _is_evidence_only(f)
   126→        and issue_in_scan_scope(str(f.get("file", "")), resolved_scan_path)
   127→        and fid not in skipped_ids
   128→    )
   129→
   130→    unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   131→    stale = current_stale_ids(state)
   132→    under_target = current_under_target_ids(state, target_strict=target_strict)
   133→
   134→    return SubjectiveVisibility(
   135→        has_objective_backlog=objective_count > 0,
   136→        objective_count=objective_count,
   137→        unscored_ids=frozenset(unscored),
   138→        stale_ids=frozenset(stale),
   139→        under_target_ids=frozenset(under_target),
   140→    )
   141→
   142→
   143→__all__ = [
   144→    "NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS",
   145→    "SubjectiveVisibility",
   146→    "compute_subjective_visibility",
   147→]
   148→

    41→def enrich_with_impact(
    42→    items: list[WorkQueueItem], dimension_scores: dict[str, Any]
    43→) -> None:
    44→    """Stamp ``estimated_impact`` on each item based on dimension-level headroom.
    45→
    46→    Impact = ``overall_per_point * headroom`` where headroom = ``100 - score``.
    47→    Items in dimensions with more score headroom sort first.
    48→    """
    49→    if not dimension_scores:
    50→        for item in items:
    51→            item["estimated_impact"] = 0.0
    52→        return
    53→
    54→    breakdown = compute_health_breakdown(dimension_scores)
    55→    entries = breakdown.get("entries", [])
    56→
    57→    # Build lookup: normalized dimension name -> {per_point, headroom}
    58→    dim_impact: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
    59→    for entry in entries:
    60→        name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
    61→        if not name:
    62→            continue
    63→        per_point = float(entry.get("overall_per_point", 0.0))
    64→        score = float(entry.get("score", 0.0))
    65→        headroom = 100.0 - score
    66→        dim_impact[name.lower()] = {"per_point": per_point, "headroom": headroom}
    67→
    68→    for item in items:
    69→        impact = _compute_item_impact(item, dim_impact, get_dimension_for_detector)
    70→        item["estimated_impact"] = impact
    71→
    72→
    73→def _compute_item_impact(
    74→    item: WorkQueueItem,
    75→    dim_impact: dict[str, dict[str, float]],
    76→    get_dimension_for_detector,
    77→) -> float:
    78→    """Compute impact value for a single queue item."""
    79→    kind = item.get("kind", "issue")
    80→
    81→    # Subjective items (synthetic dimensions or subjective issues):
    82→    # look up by detail.dimension_name
    83→    if kind == "subjective_dimension" or item.get("is_subjective"):
    84→        dim_name = detail_dict(item).get("dimension_name", "")
    85→        entry = dim_impact.get(dim_name.lower())
    86→        if entry:
    87→            return entry["per_point"] * entry["headroom"]
    88→        return 0.0
    89→
    90→    # Mechanical issues: use detector -> dimension mapping
    91→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
    92→    if detector:
    93→        dimension = get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
    94→        if dimension:
    95→            entry = dim_impact.get(dimension.name.lower())
    96→            if entry:
    97→                return entry["per_point"] * entry["headroom"]
    98→
    99→    return 0.0
   100→

   103→    raw_score: Any

   105→        detail = detail_dict(item)
   106→        raw_score = detail.get("strict_score", item.get("subjective_score", 100.0))
   107→    else:
   108→        raw_score = item.get("subjective_score", 100.0)
   109→    if raw_score is None:
   110→        return 100.0
   111→    try:
   112→        return float(raw_score)
   113→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
   114→        return 100.0

   117→def build_issue_items(
   118→    state: StateModel,
   119→    *,
   120→    scan_path: str | None,
   121→    status_filter: str,
   122→    scope: str | None,
   123→    chronic: bool,
   124→) -> list[WorkQueueItem]:
   125→    scoped = path_scoped_issues(state.get("issues", {}), scan_path)
   126→    subjective_scores = subjective_strict_scores(state)
   127→    out: list[WorkQueueItem] = []
   128→
   129→    for issue_id, issue in scoped.items():
   130→        if issue.get("suppressed"):
   131→            continue
   132→        if not status_matches(issue.get("status", "open"), status_filter):
   133→            continue
   134→        if chronic and not (
   135→            issue.get("status") == "open" and issue.get("reopen_count", 0) >= 2
   136→        ):
   137→            continue
   138→
   139→        # Evidence-only: skip issues below standalone confidence threshold
   140→        detector = issue.get("detector", "")
   141→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   142→        if meta and meta.standalone_threshold:
   143→            threshold_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(meta.standalone_threshold, 9)
   144→            issue_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(issue.get("confidence", "low"), 9)
   145→            if issue_rank > threshold_rank:
   146→                continue
   147→
   148→        item = cast(WorkQueueItem, dict(issue))
   149→        item["id"] = issue_id
   150→        item["kind"] = "issue"
   151→        item["is_review"] = is_review_issue(item)
   152→        item["is_subjective"] = is_subjective_issue(item)
   153→        item["review_weight"] = (
   154→            review_issue_weight(item) if item["is_review"] else None
   155→        )
   156→        subjective_score = None
   157→        if item["is_subjective"]:
   158→            detail = detail_dict(issue)
   159→            dim_name = detail.get("dimension_name", "")
   160→            dim_key = detail.get("dimension", "") or slugify(dim_name)
   161→            subjective_score = subjective_scores.get(
   162→                dim_key, subjective_scores.get(dim_name.lower(), 100.0)
   163→            )
   164→        item["subjective_score"] = subjective_score
   165→        supported_fixers = supported_fixers_for_item(state, item)
   166→        item["primary_command"] = primary_command_for_issue(
   167→            item,
   168→            supported_fixers=supported_fixers,
   169→        )
   170→
   171→        if not scope_matches(item, scope):
   172→            continue
   173→        out.append(item)
   174→
   175→    return out

   178→def _natural_sort_key(item: WorkQueueItem) -> tuple:
   179→    """Compute natural (non-plan-aware) ranking for queue items."""
   180→    kind = item.get("kind", "issue")
   181→
   182→    # Initial-review subjective items: highest priority
   183→    if kind == "subjective_dimension" and item.get("initial_review"):
   184→        return (_RANK_INITIAL_REVIEW, 0, subjective_score_value(item), item.get("id", ""))
   185→
   186→    # Triage stage items: stage order, blocked after unblocked
   187→    if kind == "workflow_stage":
   188→        blocked_penalty = 1 if item.get("is_blocked") else 0
   189→        stage_index = int(item.get("stage_index", 0))
   190→        return (_RANK_TRIAGE_STAGE, blocked_penalty, stage_index, item.get("id", ""))
   191→
   192→    # Workflow action items (e.g. create-plan)
   193→    if kind == "workflow_action":
   194→        return (_RANK_WORKFLOW, 0, 0, item.get("id", ""))
   195→
   196→    if kind == "cluster":
   197→        # Clusters sort before individual issues, ordered by action type
   198→        action_pri = ACTION_TYPE_PRIORITY.get(
   199→            item.get("action_type", "manual_fix"), 3
   200→        )
   201→        return (
   202→            _RANK_CLUSTER,
   203→            action_pri,
   204→            -int(item.get("member_count", 0)),
   205→            item.get("id", ""),
   206→        )
   207→
   208→    impact = item.get("estimated_impact", 0.0)
   209→
   210→    if kind == "subjective_dimension" or item.get("is_subjective"):
   211→        return (
   212→            _RANK_ISSUE,
   213→            -impact,
   214→            subjective_score_value(item),
   215→            item.get("id", ""),
   216→        )
   217→
   218→    detail = detail_dict(item)
   219→    review_weight = float(item.get("review_weight", 0.0) or 0.0)
   220→    return (
   221→        _RANK_ISSUE,
   222→        -impact,
   223→        CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(item.get("confidence", "low"), 9),
   224→        -review_weight,
   225→        -int(detail.get("count", 0) or 0),
   226→        item.get("id", ""),
   227→    )
   228→

   230→def item_sort_key(item: WorkQueueItem) -> tuple:
   231→    """Unified sort key: plan position first, then natural ranking.
   232→
   233→    When ``_plan_position`` is stamped (by :func:`stamp_plan_sort_keys`),
   234→    planned items sort first in plan order, then existing items by natural
   235→    ranking, then newly-discovered items by natural ranking.
   236→
   237→    When no plan fields are stamped, falls back to pure natural ranking.
   238→    """
   239→    plan_pos = item.get("_plan_position")
   240→
   241→    if plan_pos is not None:
   242→        kind = item.get("kind", "issue")
   243→        # Triage stages: even when explicitly planned, maintain the
   244→        # blocked-before-unblocked invariant for correctness.
   245→        if kind == "workflow_stage":
   246→            blocked = 1 if item.get("is_blocked") else 0
   247→            stage_idx = int(item.get("stage_index", 0))
   248→            return (_TIER_PLANNED, blocked, stage_idx, item.get("id", ""))
   249→        return (_TIER_PLANNED, 0, plan_pos, item.get("id", ""))
   250→
   251→    is_new = item.get("_is_new", False)
   252→    group = _TIER_NEW if is_new else _TIER_EXISTING
   253→    return (group, *_natural_sort_key(item))

   336→def group_queue_items(
   337→    items: list[WorkQueueItem], group: str
   338→) -> dict[str, list[WorkQueueItem]]:
   339→    """Group queue items for alternate output modes."""
   340→    grouped: dict[str, list[WorkQueueItem]] = {}
   341→    for item in items:
   342→        if group == "file":
   343→            key = item.get("file", "")
   344→        elif group == "detector":
   345→            key = item.get("detector", "")
   346→        elif group == "cluster":
   347→            plan_cluster = item.get("plan_cluster")
   348→            key = plan_cluster["name"] if isinstance(plan_cluster, dict) else "(unclustered)"
   349→        else:
   350→            key = "items"
   351→        grouped.setdefault(key, []).append(item)
   352→    return grouped
   353→

   113→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   114→# Unscored dimension sync (front of queue, unconditional)
   115→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   116→
   117→def sync_unscored_dimensions(
   118→    plan: PlanModel,
   119→    state: StateModel,
   120→) -> UnscoredDimensionSyncResult:
   121→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions.
   122→
   123→    1. **Prune** — remove ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are
   124→       no longer unscored AND not stale (avoids pruning stale IDs — that is
   125→       ``sync_stale_dimensions``' responsibility).
   126→    2. **Inject** — unconditionally prepend currently-unscored IDs to the
   127→       *front* of ``queue_order`` so initial reviews are the first priority.
   128→    """
   129→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   130→    result = UnscoredDimensionSyncResult()
   131→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   132→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   133→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   134→
   135→    # --- Cleanup: prune subjective IDs that are no longer unscored --------
   136→    # Only prune IDs that are neither unscored nor stale (stale sync owns those).
   137→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   138→        fid for fid in order
   139→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   140→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   141→        and fid not in stale_ids
   142→    ]
   143→    for fid in to_remove:
   144→        order.remove(fid)
   145→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   146→
   147→    # --- Inject: prepend unscored IDs after any promoted items -------------
   148→    existing = set(order)
   149→    insert_at = promoted_insertion_index(order, plan)
   150→    for uid in reversed(sorted(unscored_ids)):
   151→        if uid not in existing:
   152→            order.insert(insert_at, uid)
   153→            result.injected.append(uid)
   154→
   155→    return result
   156→
   157→
   158→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   159→# Stale dimension sync (back of queue, conditional)
   160→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   161→
   162→def sync_stale_dimensions(
   163→    plan: PlanModel,
   164→    state: StateModel,
   165→    *,
   166→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   167→    cycle_just_completed: bool = False,
   168→) -> StaleDimensionSyncResult:
   169→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with stale and under-target subjective dimensions.
   170→
   171→    1. Remove any ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are no
   172→       longer stale/under-target and not unscored (avoids pruning IDs owned
   173→       by ``sync_unscored_dimensions``).
   174→    2. Inject stale and under-target dimension IDs when either:
   175→       a. No objective items remain (mid-cycle: append to back), OR
   176→       b. A cycle just completed (post-cycle: insert at front so subjective
   177→          review takes priority over new objective issues).
   178→    """
   179→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   180→    result = StaleDimensionSyncResult()
   181→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   182→    under_target_ids = current_under_target_ids(state)
   183→    injectable_ids = stale_ids | under_target_ids
   184→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   185→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   186→
   187→    # --- Cleanup: prune resolved subjective IDs --------------------------
   188→    # Only prune IDs that are no longer injectable and not unscored.
   189→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   190→        fid for fid in order
   191→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   192→        and fid not in injectable_ids
   193→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   194→    ]
   195→    for fid in to_remove:
   196→        order.remove(fid)
   197→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   198→
   199→    # --- Inject or evict stale + under-target dimensions -----------------
   200→    if policy is not None:
   201→        has_real_items = policy.has_objective_backlog
   202→    else:
   203→        has_real_items = any(
   204→            f.get("status") == "open"
   205→            and f.get("detector") not in _NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   206→            and not f.get("suppressed")
   207→            for f in state.get("issues", {}).values()
   208→        )
   209→
   210→    should_inject = not has_real_items or cycle_just_completed
   211→
   212→    if not should_inject:
   213→        # Mid-cycle with objective backlog: evict any stale/under-target IDs
   214→        # that are present in the queue.  They may have been grandfathered from
   215→        # the unscored phase and should not be visible until the objective
   216→        # backlog clears or a cycle completes.
   217→        to_evict = [
   218→            fid for fid in order
   219→            if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   220→            and fid in injectable_ids
   221→        ]
   222→        for fid in to_evict:
   223→            order.remove(fid)
   224→            result.pruned.append(fid)
   225→
   226→    if should_inject and injectable_ids:
   227→        existing = set(order)
   228→        if cycle_just_completed and has_real_items:
   229→            # Post-cycle: front-of-queue after promoted items so subjective
   230→            # review happens before the new objective cycle begins.
   231→            insert_at = promoted_insertion_index(order, plan)
   232→            for sid in reversed(sorted(injectable_ids)):
   233→                if sid not in existing:
   234→                    order.insert(insert_at, sid)
   235→                    result.injected.append(sid)
   236→        else:
   237→            # Mid-cycle or no objective backlog: append to back.
   238→            for sid in sorted(injectable_ids):
   239→                if sid not in existing:
   240→                    order.append(sid)
   241→                    result.injected.append(sid)
   242→
   243→    return result
   244→

   269→
   270→def sync_triage_needed(
   271→    plan: PlanModel,
   272→    state: StateModel,
   273→) -> TriageSyncResult:
   274→    """Inject 4 triage stage IDs at front of queue when review issues change.
   275→
   276→    Only injects stages not already confirmed in ``epic_triage_meta``.
   277→
   278→    When stages are already present but all new issues have been resolved
   279→    since injection, auto-prunes the stale stages and updates the hash.
   280→
   281→    When issues are *resolved* (current IDs are a subset of previously
   282→    triaged IDs), the snapshot hash is updated silently — no re-triage
   283→    is needed since the user is working through the plan.
   284→    """
   285→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   286→    result = TriageSyncResult()
   287→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   288→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   289→    confirmed = set(meta.get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   290→
   291→    # Check if any triage stage is already in queue
   292→    already_present = any(sid in order for sid in TRIAGE_IDS)
   293→
   294→    current_hash = review_issue_snapshot_hash(state)
   295→    last_hash = meta.get("issue_snapshot_hash", "")
   296→
   297→    if already_present:
   298→        # Stages present — check if the reason for injection still applies.
   299→        # Only auto-prune when triage was completed before (hash exists),
   300→        # all new issues have been resolved, and no triage work is in
   301→        # progress.  This avoids pruning the initial triage or a
   302→        # user-started triage session.
   303→        if last_hash and not confirmed:
   304→            issues = state.get("issues", {})
   305→            current_review_ids = {
   306→                fid for fid, f in issues.items()
   307→                if f.get("status") == "open"
   308→                and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   309→            }
   310→            triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   311→            new_since_triage = current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   312→
   313→            if not new_since_triage:
   314→                # No new issues remain — prune stale stages
   315→                for sid in TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS:
   316→                    while sid in order:
   317→                        order.remove(sid)
   318→                if current_hash:
   319→                    meta["issue_snapshot_hash"] = current_hash
   320→                    plan["epic_triage_meta"] = meta
   321→                result.pruned = True
   322→        return result
   323→
   324→    if current_hash and current_hash != last_hash:
   325→        # Distinguish "new issues appeared" from "issues were resolved".
   326→        # Only re-triage when genuinely new issues exist.
   327→        issues = state.get("issues", {})
   328→        current_review_ids = {
   329→            fid for fid, f in issues.items()
   330→            if f.get("status") == "open"
   331→            and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   332→        }
   333→        triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   334→        new_since_triage = current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   335→
   336→        if new_since_triage:
   337→            # New review issues appeared — re-triage needed
   338→            insert_at = promoted_insertion_index(order, plan)
   339→            stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   340→            existing = set(order)
   341→            injected_count = 0
   342→            for sid, name in zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names, strict=False):
   343→                if name not in confirmed and sid not in existing:
   344→                    order.insert(insert_at + injected_count, sid)
   345→                    injected_count += 1
   346→            if injected_count:
   347→                result.injected = True
   348→        else:
   349→            # Only resolved issues changed the hash — update silently
   350→            meta["issue_snapshot_hash"] = current_hash
   351→            plan["epic_triage_meta"] = meta
   352→
   353→    return result
   354→

   544→@dataclass
   545→class CommunicateScoreSyncResult:
   546→    """What changed during a communicate-score sync."""
   547→
   548→    injected: bool = False
   549→
   550→    @property
   551→    def changes(self) -> int:
   552→        return int(self.injected)
   553→
   554→
   555→def sync_communicate_score_needed(
   556→    plan: PlanModel,
   557→    state: StateModel,
   558→    *,
   559→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   560→    scores_just_imported: bool = False,
   561→) -> CommunicateScoreSyncResult:
   562→    """Inject ``workflow::communicate-score`` when scores should be shown.
   563→
   564→    Injects when either:
   565→    - All initial subjective reviews are complete (no unscored dimensions), OR
   566→    - Scores were just imported (trusted/attested/override)
   567→
   568→    And ``workflow::communicate-score`` is not already in the queue.
   569→    Positioned after subjective items but before triage/create-plan.
   570→    """
   571→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   572→    result = CommunicateScoreSyncResult()
   573→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   574→
   575→    # Also treat legacy score-checkpoint as already-present
   576→    if WORKFLOW_COMMUNICATE_SCORE_ID in order or WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID in order:
   577→        return result
   578→
   579→    # Trigger 1: scores just imported
   580→    should_inject = scores_just_imported
   581→
   582→    # Trigger 2: all initial reviews complete (no unscored dimensions)
   583→    if not should_inject:
   584→        if policy is not None:
   585→            should_inject = not policy.unscored_ids
   586→        else:
   587→            should_inject = not current_unscored_ids(state)
   588→
   589→    if not should_inject:
   590→        return result
   591→
   592→    # Insert after any subjective items, before triage/workflow/issues
   593→    insert_at = 0
   594→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   595→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX):
   596→            insert_at = i + 1
   597→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_COMMUNICATE_SCORE_ID)
   598→    result.injected = True
   599→    return result
   600→
   601→
   602→__all__ = [
   603→    "SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX",
   604→    "TRIAGE_ID",
   605→    "TRIAGE_IDS",
   606→    "TRIAGE_PREFIX",
   607→    "TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS",
   608→    "SYNTHETIC_PREFIXES",
   609→    "WORKFLOW_COMMUNICATE_SCORE_ID",
   610→    "WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID",
   611→    "WORKFLOW_IMPORT_SCORES_ID",
   612→    "WORKFLOW_PREFIX",
   613→    "WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID",
   614→    "CommunicateScoreSyncResult",
   615→    "CreatePlanSyncResult",
   616→    "ImportScoresSyncResult",
   617→    "ScoreCheckpointSyncResult",
   618→    "StaleDimensionSyncResult",
   619→    "TriageSyncResult",
   620→    "UnscoredDimensionSyncResult",
   621→    "current_under_target_ids",
   622→    "current_unscored_ids",
   623→    "compute_new_issue_ids",
   624→    "is_triage_stale",
   625→    "review_issue_snapshot_hash",
   626→    "sync_communicate_score_needed",
   627→    "sync_create_plan_needed",
   628→    "sync_import_scores_needed",
   629→    "sync_score_checkpoint_needed",
   630→    "sync_stale_dimensions",
   631→    "sync_triage_needed",
   632→    "sync_unscored_dimensions",
   633→]

   384→        [],
   385→        dimension_scores={
   386→            "Naming quality": {"score": 50.0, "strict": 50.0, "failing": 1, "stale": True},
   387→        },
   388→    )
   389→    # threshold=-10 clamps to 0.0 -> score 50 >= 0 -> item excluded
   390→    queue = build_work_queue(
   391→        state, count=None, include_subjective=True, subjective_threshold=-10
   392→    )
   393→    subj_items = [item for item in queue["items"] if item["kind"] == "subjective_dimension"]
   394→    assert subj_items == []
   395→
   396→    # threshold=200 clamps to 100.0 -> score 50 < 100 -> item included
   397→    queue2 = build_work_queue(
   398→        state, count=None, include_subjective=True, subjective_threshold=200
   399→    )
   400→    subj_items2 = [item for item in queue2["items"] if item["kind"] == "subjective_dimension"]
   401→    assert len(subj_items2) >= 1
   402→

   638→# ── Impact-based ordering ──────────────────────────────────
